publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, we design a positioning system for permanent magnet based on three-axis digital magnetic sensor array to achieve accurate positioning of capsule endoscope. The permanent magnet is equivalent to a magnetic dipole model and fixed in the capsule, the host computer receives the magnetic flux density data measured by the magnetic sensor array through serial port. We propose a method combining particle swarm optimization and Levenberg-Marquard (L-M) algorithm to calculate position and direction parameters of the permanent magnet, and display real-time trajectory tracking through the graphical interface in MATLAB. The system takes 0.2 seconds to complete positioning once, and positioning error of the system is 0.479 cm.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid DC-Link Capacitor Bank with High Efficiency and Long-Life Time
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Electrolytic capacitors are the common selection in inverters' DC-link for absorbing energy during switching transient and buffering power surge during grid ride-through. Electrolytic capacitors must be derating in order to accomplish the life time requirement of inverters. The hybrid DC-link capacitor bank which combines electrolytic capacitors and film capacitors are investigated for this issue. In the proposed hybrid DC-link capacitor bank, ripple currents are handled by the high- performance film capacitor, which leads to lower temperature rise in electrolytic capacitors. As a result, life time extension is obtained. Comprehensive simulation and experiments support the benefit in life-time extension of hybrid DC-link capacitor bank.

articleTitle: Scale-adaptive and Color-corrected Retinex Defogging Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a Retinex defogging algorithm for scale adaptation and color correction.This algorithm can solve the problem that the Retinex defogging algorithm needs to manually set the Gaussian parameters and the color cast of the image after defogging. Firstly, the fog concentration is estimated by the transmittance of the dark channel prior theory, and the piecewise function between the fog concentration and the defogging scale is constructed, so that the scale is selected according to different fog concentrations adaptively; Secondly, the brightness and color of the image are adjusted to the level similar to the original image by using the numerical characteristics of the image. From the comparison with the MSRCR algorithm, the algorithm has better color recovery effect, outstanding detail and good visual effect.

articleTitle: Analysis of Thermal Instability in Power MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, the behavior of thermal instability in power MOSFET is investigated. It is shown that the device is at risk of thermal instability when the current has a positive temperature coefficient. The MOSFET current has a positive temperature coefficient when gate voltage is less than temperature compensation point. The model and experimental data show that the sufficient condition for the thermal instability in the device is S>1. The drain voltage has a large effect on the thermal instability of the device, and the device with a large transconductance has poor thermal stability. Finally, the thermal images demonstrate that even at a steady-state temperature field, there is no uniform temperature and current on the surface of the chip, and the difference is greater in the unstable region. The results confirm that the burnout of chip is caused by local hot spot.

articleTitle: Short text classification based on word2vec and improved TDFIDF merge weighting
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the amount of information in contemporary society has proliferated exponentially. It contains not only the information we need, but also the redundant information that we do not need. Therefore, how to pass the massive data the algorithm processing, filtering out the information we do not need, has always been a hotspot in the field of information retrieval. TF-IDF is one of the statistical methods, but the traditional TF-IDF method simply highlights the importance of small frequency vocabulary, but it does not reflect the role of the keyword in the context; once encountered some very useful vocabulary, it will have a bad influence on the classification results. Therefore, we introduce the word2vec model and the improved TFIDF algorithm for combining weights. Experiments show that the model retrieval results are better than the traditional two models.

articleTitle: An improved remote sensing image blind deblurring algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The remote sensing image acquisition may become blurred and the texture is unclear due to the remote sensor's jitter, defocusing and other factors. Therefore, deblurring remote sensing images is a major problem in remote sensing research. In order to improve the quality of remote sensing images, an improved blind deblurring algorithm for remote sensing images based on dark channel prior is proposed. First, the blur kernel estimation based on the dark channel prior is performed, and then the image deconvolution is performed using the estimated blur kernel to achieve clear image restoration. A joint bilateral filter is introduced to maintain the image detail and enhance edges for the image ringing effect produced during the original clear image restoration process. The experimental results show that the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of the objective evaluation index of this method is improved by about 1.5dB, and the structural similarity (SSIM) is improved by about 0.04. Compared with the existing image deblurring algorithm, this method can estimate the blur information more accurately, so that the restored result image can achieve the effect of maintaining the edge to remove the ringing.

articleTitle: An Improved Spatial Topological Relationship Model and Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: It is difficult to describe various and complex topological relationship between of point, line and area in Geographic Information System (GIS). Aiming at the above problem, this paper constructs an extended 9 intersection matrix topological relationship analysis model and outputs a string to judge type of the return entity by set operations, and it can distinguish the topological relationship between spatial entities on the basis of 9 intersection model. This paper has given implementation steps of the scalable 9 intersection matrix topological relationship algorithm. The experimental results show that, compared with ArcGIS software, the improved algorithm can analyze topological relationship between entities accurately and effectively, and the accuracy of calculation result is the same as ArcGIS software. But, the algorithm execution time is significantly reduced in some of spatial relationships.

articleTitle: A New Initial Beam Search Scheme in 5G New Radio
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Initial access (IA) is the process that a user equipment (UE) establishes initial connection to the base station (BS). In 5G new radio (NR), millimeter wave (mmWave) bands and directional beamforming (BF) are introduced. Hence, the IA process need to provide a beam search mechanism by which the BS and UE can determine their respective initial BF directions for subsequent directional communications. In particular, initial beam search can significantly delay the IA process, which goes against the ultra-low latency feature in the NR network. This article proposes two new initial beam search schemes - dynamic single-side iterative search and hybrid dynamic iterative search. We campare the delay performance of these two new proposals and the exhaustive search.

articleTitle: Design of Fuzzy-PID Speed Controller for Brushless DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The traditional PID control method has the disadvantages of slow response speed, low precision and poor anti-interference ability when controlling the brushless DC motor system. In view of these shortcomings, a fuzzy PID control based brushless DC motor control system was proposed. The principle and characteristics of fuzzy control were introduced; The control principle of PID control based on fuzzy rules was analyzed; The fuzzy subsets were established and fuzzy control rules were established; The simulation of brushless DC motor control system was simulated by Matlab/Simulink. The results showed that the PID control algorithm based on fuzzy logic control improved the dynamic performance and stronger adaptive ability of the DC brushless motor.

articleTitle: Design of Tunable Balanced Dual-band filter Using SIR and EMSIW
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper presents a compact balanced dual-band filter with the tunable first passband and the fixed second passband. The proposed filter is composed of three mental layers. Varactor diodes are loaded at the end of the stepped-impedance resonators (SIRs) to construct the tunable first passband. Two slotlines are embedded in the middle layer in order to couple signals to or from the resonators, meanwhile, the middle metal layer is also regarded as a common grounding. The eighth-mode substrate integrated waveguide (EMSIW) cavity placed in the bottom layer has been utilized to generate the fixed second passband

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis on Aircraft Main Landing Gear System Based on Simulation of GERT
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The reliability and maintainability of Aircraft Main Landing Gear System (AMLGS) is an important part of flight safety. Failure risk transmission model is established based on GERT network, in order to analyze the reliability of AMLGS. The model is an important part of failure diagnosis and reliability analysis. It optimized the series and parallel and loop structures of GERT network on typical example. Historical maintenance data of AMLGS are statistically analyzed with the method of Monte Carlo Simulation. Key Link of failure risk is exactly identified. There is practical significance to improve the development phase of reliability and maintainability of AMLGS.

articleTitle: 3D Map Merging Based on Overlapping Region
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low matching efficiency and large computation time in SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) 3D map merging of multi-robot, we propose a 3D map merging algorithm based on overlapping regions. This algorithm uses the viewpoint feature histogram and region growth segmentation to search overlapped region. Aiming at the low differentiation degree of traditional similarity function, we build a new similarity measure function by adding weight coefficient. In addition, we propose KP-PDH (Key Point and Point Dense Histogram), a new 3D descriptor, which is composed of the key point in the new coordinate and the point density projected onto the 2D plane by the neighborhood of the key point. KP-PDH descriptor effectively improves the efficiency of 3D map merging. Experimental results show that the algorithm of searching overlap region and KP-PDH descriptor can effectively reduce the matching time and mismatching rate. In this paper, our proposed algorithm increases the speed of 3D map merging, reduces the mismatching, and can be effectively applied to the multi-robot SLAM 3D map merging.

articleTitle: The Optimization Simulation of Magnetic Focus Gradient Coil For Pulsed Magnetic Field Coil
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to study how a pulsed magnetic field emission coil produces a stronger magnetic field, this paper analyzes the magnetic field distribution of single loop coil and solenoid coil. Meanwhile, this paper makes the optimization design of gradient coils, through the finite element simulation, the magnetic produced by traditional five laps coil is stronger than the traditional Lee laps coil, and the magnetic produced by gradient coil is stronger than the traditional coil. The gradient coil designed by this paper can focus the magnetic.

articleTitle: A Counteracting Non-coherent Decoys Inducing Approach for ARUAV
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing mechanism of the non-coherent decoys and amplitude of the overlap signal composed of radar signal and decoy signal, a counteracting non-coherent decoys inducing approach for anti-radiation unmanned aerial vehicle(ARUAV) is presented. Based on measurement conversion and grey theory, the amplitude of the overlap signal is analyzed, the azimuth and pitch angles are converted into the positions of the single radiating source information when pulse moment of the source appears, and these single source position datum are matched based on grey theory in real time. At last, ARUAV is able to track a certain radiating source and causes effective damage. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Face recognition algorithm based on Prewitt and convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to improve the recognition performance of face recognition algorithm, a convolutional neural network face recognition method based on Prewitt operator is proposed. Firstly, the face image is preprocessed by histogram equalization and Prewitt operator. Then, the preprocessed images are input into the convolutional neural network for training, and exponential decay method is adopted to set the learning rate to accelerate the convergence rate, and L2 regulariz ation and Dropout are used to prevent overfitting. The recognition time of this method on ORL face database is 0.2s, and the recognition rate reaches 98.1%. The experimental results show that Prewitt operator and improved convolutional neural network can shorten the recognition time and improve the recognition rate.

articleTitle: IR ship target saliency detection based on lightweight non-local depth features
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed an infrared (IR) ship target saliency detection method based on improved non-local depth features. There are mainly two contributions. First, considering the low contrast characteristics of IR images, we proposed an improved lightweight non-local depth feature method (Light-NLDF) for IR ship target saliency detection. This method mainly consists of three parts, CNN based feature extraction, top-down feature refinement with deconvolution, and improved loss function by adding structural similarity index (SSIM). Secondly, we construct an IR ship target image dataset for saliency detection. This dataset includes 3,069 IR images and ground-true images with different backgrounds and different objects. Experimental results show that our proposed method is robust and suitable for IR ship target saliency detection. By abandoning the module of contrast calculation and the fusion of global and local features, the proposed Light-NLDF can greatly improve the efficiency of training and detecting. Comparison results with two well known methods demonstrated that the proposed Light-NLDF achieves a satisfying performance for IR ship target saliency detection with a F-measure of 75.21% and a lightweight model with a size of 82 MB.

articleTitle: Principle Analysis of Coherent Two-Point Source Jamming Based on Amplitude Comparison Monopulse
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Cross-eye jamming is a kind of coherent two-point source jamming in the true sense, and its main benefit is that it is effective against monopulse tracking radars, which are largely immune to other forms of jamming. The existing analysis of cross-eye jamming mechanism is mostly based on phase-comparison monopulse model, while the amplitude-comparison model and phase-comparison model are widely used in practical application. In this paper, a comprehensive mathematical and experimental study of two-element retrodirective cross-eye jamming under the amplitude-comparison monopulse is established. The jamming mechanism of coherent two-point source jamming is fully verified in typical scenario, and the main factors affecting the jamming performance and their characteristics are analyzed.

articleTitle: Combined kernel KELM prediction model based on quantum particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Extreme learning machine is a new type single hidden layer feedforward neural network, which overcome the weakness of traditional error hack propagation method, and increase the training speed of algorithm as well as decrease the adjust time of parameter. Kernel idea was used to extreme learning machine by kernel extreme learning machine to instead random map. Kernel extreme learning machine has more looser restrictions and fewer parameters as well as more simple computational complexity and better generalization, in response to the insufficient fitting ability of kernel extreme learning machine, a kernel extreme learning machine based on multi-scale wavelet kernel and polynomial combination was presented in this paper. The presented algorithm optimize combined kernel parameters, weights, and penalty factors, and test on the UCl dataset. The experiment shows that the combined nuclear learning machine owns higher prediction accuracy and other advantages compared with SVM and single core learning machine.

articleTitle: Semantic Network Based Approach to Compute Term Semantic Similarity
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Measuring semantic similarity between two terms is essential for a variety of text analytics and understanding applications.This paper presents a approach for measuring the semantic similarity between terms. Previous work on semantic similarity methods have focused on either the structure of the semantic network between terms, or only on the Information Content (IC) of terms. However, existing approaches are limited by the size of the knowledge base and corpus. We propose an efficient and effective approach for computing semantic similarity using a large scale semantic network. This approach base on Probase, which is a big graph of concepts. Knowledge in Probase is harnessed from billions of web pages and years' worth of search logs. Through experiments performed on well known word similarity datasets, we show that our approach is much more efficient than all competing algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Power Line Segmentation and Tree Barrier Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Tree barrier analysis based on laser point cloud has been widely used in power grid industry. This grammar uses clustering idea and DBSCAN clustering method to propose a power line segmentation algorithm based on airborne laser LiDAR. By using this algorithm, we can realized the segmentation of a single power line. And it is suitable for the absence of a small range of power lines. Finally, we can carry out the tree barrier analysis by using the segmented power line. And the feasibility of the algorithm is verified by comparing with manual detection.

articleTitle: Research on Radar Plot Classification Based on Fully Connected Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Clutter is the inherent environment of radar signal detection and processing. In this paper, the full connected neural network is used to study the classification of radar clutter and real targets. First, according to the engineering experience, the multi-dimensional feature index of radar plot is given, and the fully connected neural network is built in the Tensorflow architecture. According to the application scenarios in this paper, the effect evaluation indexes of the training model were defined, and the classical loss function was optimized. Finally, the training results were given.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Restaurant Delivery Robot Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The path planning problem of dining robot is studied, and a path optimization method based on improved ant colony algorithm is proposed. Firstly, according to the working environment of dining room delivery robot, the working environment model of dining room delivery robot is established by grid method. In this paper, simple and complex two kinds of environmental models are given. Secondly, the improved ant colony algorithm adopts adaptive heuristic function, and on this basis, the state transition probability is improved to increase the attractiveness of the target point; and the optimization ant is modified by reward system. Finally, the global path planning simulation experiments of dining robot working in different environments are carried out. The results of the research verify the feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Optical Layer Awareness Based Multicast Optimization Scheme in Software Defined Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: As the scale of software defined optical networks (SDON) was enlarged with increasing multicast service demands, communication quality suffers seriously from optical layer factors. Aiming to solve this problem, an Optical Layer Awareness (OLA) based multicast optimization mechanism is proposed for OpenFlow controlled SDON. The proposed approach takes full consideration about OLA model, including linear factors and non-linear ones into optical multicast controlled by OpenFlow. Therefore, the proposed scheme is able to cover nearly all optical layer factors of all optical links. It also is capable to conduct multicast optimization with better communication quality. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme achieves better performance of SDON optical multicast services in terms of delay time and bit error rate.

articleTitle: Design of muscle fatigue monitoring system based on multi-channel bioelectrical impedance measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: We proposed a design of muscle fatigue monitoring system based on bioelectrical impedance imaging. 24 medical electrode buckles were used as measuring electrodes. The measuring circuit calculated the impedance between the electrodes and uploaded data to the MCU. Then, the data was sent to the host computer through the serial port to display the muscle electrical impedance change through dynamic imaging. The muscle fatigue was monitored as precaution injury of exhaustion.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Static Active Sonar Target Recognition Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In modern sonar systems, the automatic recognition of underwater targets has always been one of the key technologies. Active sonar is easy to be found and evaded by enemy boats when it works because of the combination of transmitter and receiver. The detection capability of passive sonar for quiet submarines is very limited. The multi-static sonar adopts the allocation of transceiver and receiver, which has the characteristics of active sonar and passive sonar. Multi-static active sonar has become the focus of research in many countries due to its unique detection advantages. In recent years, artificial intelligence has been used in the field of target recognition. Compared with the traditional recognition method based on manual, the recognition method using machine learning can learn the features of different targets more comprehensively, and mine more deep-seated feature informa-tion of data, which can effectively improve the accuracy and efficiency of recognition.

articleTitle: The influence of coupling of charge/discharge rate and short term cycle on the battery capacity of Li-ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the wide application of new energy vehicles, the research on automotive power lithium batteries has attracted a lot of attention. However, the battery life problem of power electric vehicles is a major factor that plagues the development of lithium batteries. In the present paper, the standard 18650 batteries were cycled for 200 numbers at discharge ratio of 2C to analyze the variation characteristics of the internal battery capacity. In addition, the batteries were cycled at different discharge ratio to investigate the influence of coupling of charge/discharge rate and short term cycle on the battery capacity. The results found that the internal capacity of the battery was reduced with the increase of the number of charge and discharge cycles. In addition, the battery capacity was also decreased with the increase of the discharge ratio. The results is significant studying how to promote the safe and orderly operation of lithium-ion batteries.

articleTitle: Research on PRT station design using unmanned vehicles based on Petri net
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to better complete the transportation between venue and venue and between venue and centralized accommodation during the large events, people consider to use unmanned vehicles for personnel transportation. PRT stations are set up next to each venue and centralized accommodation, and centralized scheduling is used to control vehicle parking, which is convenient for people to get on and off. According to the theory of traffic flow avoidance and conflict points, public resource points are divided. The control model of the unmanned vehicle of the PRT station is established by using the time-delay Petri net. According to the actual flow rules, the HCM model is established, and the number of PRT stations is rationally designed through the optimization, and the maximum utilization of resources is achieved on the basis of ensuring service quality.

articleTitle: Research on Point Aggregation Algorithm Based on WebGL
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: WebGL has the advantages of online interaction and hardware accelerated rendering to serve web maps. When there are a large number of spatial points in the visible area of the map that need to be visually expressed, the method of extracting and abstracting the distribution rules and intensiveness of the local spatial points can be achieved through technical synthesis of these spatial points, so as to achieve an objective and comprehensive display space by using limited areas. This paper focuses on the related technologies and principles of WebGL-based point aggregation visualization. The advantages and disadvantages of the algorithm are analyzed according to the aggregation process of the algorithm, and the algorithm is optimized.

articleTitle: Deformable Convolutional Neural Network for Fine-grained Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning techniques have demonstrated their powerful feature extraction capabilities in a variety of visual analysis tasks. Especially in the field of fine-grained image classification, deep feature extraction technology has achieved great performance improvement. The depth features extracted based on the deep learning model have strong expressive power. Fine-grained image classification is intended to subclass large categories, such as different types of birds. This identification task is more challenging because these sub-classes have large interclass differences and small inter-class differences. This paper first introduces the research progress of fine-grained image classification. Then, the data set used in the experiment and the extended data set are introduced. A variable convolution method for fine-grained image classification is proposed, and the research direction of the next step is summarized and explored.

articleTitle: Full-Power Train and The Design of Permanent Magnetic Coupler
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: A drum-type permanent magnet coupler is designed in this paper, which can solve the problem of noise and vibration caused by too many motors in full-power train. It provides a feasible scheme for realizing full-power train. 200 km/h locomotive is taken as an example in this paper. The power of the motor required by the full-power train is calculated and the appropriate motor is selected. Secondly, according to the equivalent magnetic charge theory, the mathematical model of the torque of the magnetic coupler is established. Finally, the size of the coupler is designed by adjusting the structural parameters of the coupler.

articleTitle: Containerization of intelligent terminal application in Ubiquitous Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the rapid construction of the ubiquitous power internet of things, the increasing demand of embedded hardware usage and the complex usage scenario of the embedded platform hardware in intelligent terminal. A more efficient vitalization solution was demanded. With the analysis of traditional virtualization solutions and the armv8 architecture embedded platform hardware support for virtualization, the implementation details of arm embedded platform supporting containerization technology are described. In particular, the specific steps of application containerization are introduced. In the end, we analyze the performance that application run in container and discuss future research directions.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Technology in UHV Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: UHV substation will accumulate a large amount of data during the operation process. The data scale and growth rate are unmatched by UHV substations. How to effectively use these rich data resources for business decision-making is an urgent problem to be solved. Big data technology provides a new solution for the operation and maintenance of UHV substations. The data collected by the sensors in the station into the substation cloud platform, the development of various application subsystems based on the cloud platform can facilitate inspection and fault prediction, and greatly optimize human resources. This paper first analyzes the source and characteristics of current UHV substation data, defines the research scope of UHV substation data subordinate to big data, and then discusses how big data technology can help UHV operation and maintenance work from two aspects of intelligent inspection and fault prediction. This paper introduces the new inspection mode, introduces the working ideas of using big data technology for fault discovery and prediction, and finally proposes a cloud platform design scheme based on Hadoop distributed cluster, and forecasts the related trends.

articleTitle: Class Prediction Performance Boost Using Gaussian Mixture Models
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Fine-grained image classification remains a challenging task due to subtle visual differences between subordinate categories. Most existing approaches focus on improving key parts detection ability and feature extraction ability of neural networks, while our approach focuses on improving class prediction ability with Gaussian mixture models. Gaussian mixture layers (GML), which learn Gaussian mixture feature distribution and predict classes, are designed to replace fully connection layer, or placed right after them. Experiment results indicate that classification performance can be improved significantly by using GML on top of VGG model. In addition, GML are compatible with any neural networks that contains fully connection layers, which enables them to further boost the performance of cutting-edge classification networks.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation and Optimized Selection of Mechanical Products Based on Entropy Weight and Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to provide a reference basis for choosing a relatively more advantaged belt conveyor tensioning device product among various other similar products that have the same function for customers, we set up the mathematical model of comprehensive evaluation and optimized selection in this paper. The evaluation indicators are chosen from the economic, technical and social perspectives products. The superior membership function is used to normalize the different dimensions between the evaluation indicators to get a decision matrix, the entropy weight method and the analytic hierarchy process are used to determine the comprehensive weight values of the evaluation indicators, and the evaluation results are obtained by weighting operations.

articleTitle: Design of Control System for Marine Power Station based on Redundant Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Based on the experimental platform of marine power station, a redundant control system is designed by taking the S7- 1200 programmable logic controller (PLC) as the core controller. It is fully compatible with the requirements related to continuity and reliability of power system in the normal navigation. Then, the reliability and mean time between failures (MTBF) are obtained from a mathematical model based on Markov process. Research result indicates that the MTBF of the control system with redundant technology is 1.49 times of the primary control system, and the reliability is increased by 39.85% in five years. Moreover, a human machine interface (HMI) in type of WEINVIEW MT8100i is employed to monitor the status. The experimental results show that the redundant control system can completely actualize automatic functions and ensure stable operation particularly in a fault state by using the hot standby redundancy. The designed scheme effectively improves the reliability and has good application prospects, which provides the reference for the redundant design of small PLCs.

articleTitle: Configuration Synthesis of Side Door Latch Power Release Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: For satisfying the need of vehicle electrical release function, and a new power release kinematic branch chain is added for the latch only existing vehicle side door latch with inside release and outside release function, based on planar mechanism topological graph theory. The topological configuration synthesis of inside release, outside release and power release is integrated by a single open chain superposition method. The structure of the mechanism is described by using the double-colors topological graph of the single-opened chain and the topology graph with three release branch chain is obtained. Constrained by the movement compatibility of each kinematic branch in the door latch, the structure type that satisfies the functional requirements is preferably selected, and the configuration design of the power release function is realized. Finally, the preferred scheme complete the power release kinematic branch by adding motor, worm gear and other driving mechanisms, and make a physical latch to verify the feasibility of the program.

articleTitle: A Channel Estimation Algorithm based on the Basis Extension Model for the High-Speed Railway Environments
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The channel estimation is often a difficult task and has also attracted broad attention in wireless communications. This paper provides a fast time-varying channel model for the highspeed railway environments. Then, a channel estimation algorithm based on the basis extension model (BEM) is proposed for the Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) system, which is often adopted in the high-speed moving communication systems. In simulations, the performance of the proposed channel estimation algorithm is compared under the different signal noise ratios (SNRs), Doppler frequency shifts and channel models which consist of different basis functions.

articleTitle: Baseline Length Estimation Method Based on Binocular Stereo Vision Perception
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the emergence of various 3D stereo imaging devices, stereo viewing has become more and more popular. At the same time, since the technologies of such as WEBGL are used, the design and implementation of 3D scene becomes easier. But most of the WEBGL designs are for single-eye situations. For binocular stereo vision scenarios, we should reasonably design the baseline length of left and right cameras and the related viewing distance and angle. Binocular stereo vision related papers have done a lot of research on the design of stereo vision parameters, but the relationship between baseline length, viewing distance and viewing angle of two cameras for WEBGL scene rendering combined with human eye perception and stereo scene has not been deeply discussed. This paper presents a series of relationship functions with the baseline length of rendered scene, viewing distance and viewing angle combining the binocular stereo vision and imagining theory. The relationship functions are analyzed through experiments. The experimental results show that the method has a good theoretical guidance for setting the relevant parameters reasonably.

articleTitle: Design of RF Temperature Measurement System Based on Polymer Derived Ceramic Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The polymer derived ceramic (PDC) sensor is a wireless passive sensor that can measure high temperatures. The sensor is based on the resonant cavity principle. At different temperatures, the resonant frequency of the sensor will change. According to this characteristic, the sensor sends a radio frequency signal of a certain frequency band, and then the reflected signal returned by the sensor is analyzed to obtain its resonant frequency, and the temperature value can be obtained. The design idea of this text can be divided into two points: First, how to produce the radio frequency signal of certain frequency band and transmit the radio frequency signal to the sensor. Secondly, how to collect the reflected signal of the sensor and get the resonant frequency through the reflected signal.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Query and Reasoning Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of sparse information distribution and lack of good correlation between data in the era of big data, this paper proposes a knowledge graph query and reasoning method based on game theory. This method first establishes the domain ontology model according to the domain requirements, and establishes the domain knowledge graph according to the modified model, and then uses the PageRank algorithm to evaluate the value of each node in the knowledge graph, and then conducts the knowledge graph query based on the game thinking orientation and the talent recommendation system as an example. This method makes use of the relationship between knowledge and nodes in the knowledge graph and realizes the effective talent recommendation.

articleTitle: Study on Levelness Checks and Adjustment of Guns by Taking Use of Electronic Level Meters
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: It is necessary to keep a weapon system with high precision constantly to fully exercise the maximum efficiency of a gun weapon system. It is important to check and correct levelness errors among each part of the system so as to ensure a good precision of the system. By a conventional levelness checking method, two quadrants are placed on two different platforms handled by two operators who need to have very good coordination in the work, but it is difficult to carry the work well if the platforms are not fixed. In this article, electronic leveling and computer technology are discussed, by which angle of inclinations are automatically sampled at the same moment and automatically processed, so this method is easy, fast and economical. A large number of tests show that by this method, shortcomings in a conventional method can be avoided and high precision levelness checks can be realized in a dynamic state.

articleTitle: Design of wireless acoustic emission data acquisition system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: As the hub of the traffic system, bridges will be damaged in a long period of bad environment, which leads to the weakening of its external force, which will seriously cause the collapse of the bridge. Acoustic emission is a transient elastic wave generated by the rapid release of energy from local sources within the material under external stress. This kind of stress wave emission can be used for nondestructive testing, and has the effect that other non-destructive testing methods can not replace. By collecting the random characteristic signal of the material and extracting the eigenvalue, the damage of the bridge is analyzed. According to the principle of acoustic emission detection, a set of wireless acoustic emission data acquisition system based on FPGA is designed. The random characteristic signal is collected through 4 high speed AD modules. After the FPGA sorts related data that order cache and SD card are stored in the SD card by the wireless serial port. It is sent to the PC host computer for storage and display, and is used for later data analysis.

articleTitle: Optimal Analysis of Target Dynamic Tracking Strategy Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Computer vision is a highly intensive interdisciplinary subject which combines artificial intelligence and advanced algorithms, and its target tracking has become a hot research topic at present. At the operational level of target tracking, PF(Particle Filter) technology has its own technical advantages in processing image interpretation interference and target movement change. On the one hand, BPNN(Back Propagation Neural Network) technology is introduced to improve the diversity of particles and improve the accuracy of target information at the next moment so as to meet the dual requirements of dynamic intelligent capture and timeliness at the next moment of target tracking; on the other hand, PSO(Particle Swarm Optimization) technology is introduced to prevent particle degradation and quickly find the global optimal solution of particle information. The simulation results show that the method of using BPNN + PSO to improve the particle filter algorithm, not only improves the accuracy of target tracking information, but also reduces the timeconsuming of target tracking.

articleTitle: Design of decentralized personal loaning platform based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the growth of Internet and computer technology in the world, the p2p loaning model has gradually caught the attention of many, but with the exposure of its flaws, the issues of its insufficient credibility and regulatory confusion have sequentially emerged. The emergence of blockchain and smart contract technology have brought new solutions to curb these issues. Smart contracts can be directly used to control transfer and trading of digital assets. The blockchain environment ensures that the entire transaction process is transparent, which invisibly increases the credibility of the loaning platform and reduces series of problems caused by inadequate supervision. This paper proposes a personal loaning platform based on the blockchain technology and illustrates in detail the design and business process of the smart contract. Experiments show that the smart contract implementation on the blockchain of personal loaning completes the steps of borrowing, repayment and compensation smoothly.

articleTitle: Special Library Cart with Automatic Following Function
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Based on UWB range-based localization technology, this special library cart with automatic following function changes its traditional mode of manual pushing and realizes an automatic positioning mode, which greatly reduces the work burden of library staff. At the same time, coupled with RFID radio frequency identification technology and display screen, the book name in the cart as well as its bookshelf number and location can be displayed automatically, so as to reduce the probability of books on the wrong shelf and greatly improve the efficiency of the library staff.

articleTitle: Geographic Information System Based on Thermal Aging Data of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of transmission network, how to better detect and manage transmission line network has become the focus of research. This paper uses Matlab to process the thermal aging of meteorological data at different measuring points in a certain region and different periods, and then extends to the analysis of the thermal aging loss of the whole line. Finally, the loss data of each line in the region is imported into the software ArcGIS[1] to form a visual geographic information system based on the thermal aging data of transmission lines. The system can effectively understand the working state and thermal aging degree of transmission lines. In this paper, 109 sets of data were collected and processed in Shandong province, and finally a visualization system which met the expected results was obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Substation Gantry Modeling Based on IFC Standard
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: BIM technology plays an important role in design and construction. IFC standard is a principal standard for BIM data exchange. In this paper, IFC standard is extended to substation gantry. The spatial and physical structure expression of substation gantry based on IFC is studied, and the data system of substation gantry information model is established. Substation gantry modeling based on IFC standard provides a method for data exchange of substation 3D model and will promote substation 3D design.

articleTitle: Synchronization control for a new class of fractional-order chaotic systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Based on a new class of integer-order generalized chaotic systems, the corresponding fractional-order generalized three-dimensional autonomous systems are proposed. According to the stability theory of fractional order systems and the synchronization problem in fractional order systems, combined with the definition and properties of fractional differential equations, the synchronization control of the fractional order generalized Lü chaotic systems is studied., and by adding suitable controllers to the system, it can synchronize the drive system and the response system quickly. Numerical simulations verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the controller.

articleTitle: An approach for optimizing of the aerospace software regression test cases
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Owing to complex development phases and frequent requirement changes of the aerospace software, the workload of the regression test is more than half of the total amount of software test. And aerospace software requires high reliability, so each revision of the test requirements must be covered in the process of the regression testing. Therefore in the process of the aerospace software regression test it is an urgent problem be solved that how to complete the full coverage of the changes under the less manpower cost. In this paper, an approach for optimizing of the aerospace software regression test cases is proposed, which can save more test resources and ensure the coverage of the changed contents.

articleTitle: Attitude correction of stratospheric airship based on damped oscillation model
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to improve the attitude measurement accuracy of the stratospheric airship, a stochastic process of damped oscillation autocorrelation is proposed to model the attitude angular velocity of the stratospheric airship, and the state transition matrix and the process noise covariance matrix of the model are derived. Based on this, the Kalman filter algorithm is used to correct the attitude angle measurement of the stratospheric airship. Finally, the model is compared with Singer model, Jerk model and sinusoidal correlation model by simulation experiment and the influence of parameter selection on model effect is analyzed. The results demonstrate the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed model in correcting the attitude angle of the stratospheric airship.

articleTitle: A Situation Forecast Method Based on Improved Double Feedback Elman Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In view of the existing problems of the current situation forecast methods based on Elman neural network, this paper introduces the trend correction factor in the situation forecast model, adjusts the trend correction factor based on the trend change direction of the predicted value and the actual value, and proposes a situation forecast method based on the adjustment factor of the double feedback Elman neural network. The experimental results show that the predictive power of the double feedback Elman neural network based on the adjustment factor is obviously better than the comparison forecast methods.

articleTitle: Risk Identification of Power System Cascading Failure Based on Operation Status and Natural Disaster Warning Information
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The power system has extremely uncertain characteristics, but the existing cascading fault deterministic method and random evaluation method cannot distinguish the possibility of each accident. This paper proposes the identification of power system cascading failure risk based on grid operation status and natural disaster warning information. This method analyzes the impact of cascading failures on the system, and uses "fuzziness" to describe the uncertainty of chain faults. Based on the principle of harmonization and randomness and credibility theory, the cascading failures are characterized as fuzzy events. The experimental results prove the correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of Skin Color Segmentation Method Based on Different Color Space
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Face detection has been a more and more popular method for face recognition today. Face recognition has been used in many places such as image retrieval, video monitoring, military base and other sensitive areas of access control. There are three key steps in face recognition:face detection, feature extraction and feature matching. Face detection has been the first and the most important step in the whole process of face recognition. Skin color segmentation is an important part of face detection. Through the establishment and comparison of skin color models in three different color Spaces of RGB, HSV and YCbCr, YCbCr color space was finally determined as the ideal skin color modeling space. Some improvements are made in some way. That is to change the parameters of the transformation matrix used in the conversion from RGB space to YCbCr color space. The selected skin color region is closer to the face skin color region, so that the system can detect the face most accurately.

articleTitle: Design of King Glory’s Game Query System Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The King Glory is a multiplayer tower defense sports game. This paper is based on Python to implement a game hero information query system. First, the crawler technology is used to get the hero information from the webpage, then the layered architecture is used to develop the software system and experiment on two computers. The user selects the specified hero name in the client interface to get the hero's title and skill information. The experimental results show that the system can query the details of the hero skills in the game.

articleTitle: Based on the OSGi framework LIS isomers Big data collection practice
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The collection and utilization of big data information is changing the concept and method of collecting data. For the new situation map information acquisition, the challenge than the greatest collection of vast amounts of heterogeneous information from the network, extraction, analysis and other operations. Heterogeneous network information such as blogs, news and user behaviors are gradually becoming an important part of the attention and collection in the field of graphics. At the same time, the collection of heterogeneous big data information is a difficult problem for the graphic workers. In this paper, through the heterogeneous big data collection mechanism of OSGi framework, the application of graph-related big data is practiced, and it is hoped that it can provide a heterogeneous graph information collection idea for peers.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Mode and Risk Prediction of Security Vulnerability Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the Internet age, the acquisition and trading of security vulnerabilities will become a hot spot. This paper firstly analyzes the background and definition of network security vulnerabilities, then analyzes the existing security vulnerabilities platform in the market, and finally introduces the Markov model with profit risk analysis to evaluate the profit of related companies. The experimental results show that in the market environment, different security vulnerability platform companies have the opportunity to profit and share the entire growing market, but the risk of loss still exists.

articleTitle: Application of Pattern Filter Method on Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearing Vibration Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Almost any of electronic device widely used in daily life is a mixed-signal system, there are various aliasing components in a measured signal. It has great significance and practical value to carry out the study on single-channel multi-component signal separation. In order to extract various sub-wave signal from mixture signals in low signal-to-noise ratio, we introduce a signal processing method called Patter Filter Method(PFM), which is helpful for rolling bearing fault extraction and diagnosis. Bearing vibration signals are obtained from bearing data center site, Case Western Reserve University, USA. Based on time-frequency analysis for these signals, PFM is adopted to achieve the optimal decomposition of signals, followed by discrimination, classification, sorting and reconstruction for these signals. Then, characteristics of rolling bearing fault signals under different conditions are effectively extracted. The results verify the validity and practicability of pattern filter method in the periodic impact feature extraction from vibration signal, providing available guidance for automatic extraction of rolling bearing characteristics, rolling bearing fault identification and diagnosis.

articleTitle: High precision over-the-horizon time transfer by a 40.5km tropospheric link
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: High precision time synchronization is of vital importance for the distributed system's normal operation. One way troposphere time transfer (OWT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) is one of implemented means to achieve high precision over-the-horizon time synchronization. In this paper, we put forth OWT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> to achieve the system's time synchronization and operated an outfield experiment. Firstly, the construction of OWT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> has been established. Then we studied troposcatter channel's influences on OWT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> theoretically. Besides, an outfield experiment was carried out over a 40.5km tropospheric link between Xi'an and Sanyuan. From the experiment, we could conclude that OWT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> is a feasible time synchronization means for distributed system. Normal demodulation condition of OWT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> is that the signal power after down-conversion is 20 dBm around. And troposcatter channel's influences on OWT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> system are about 37.0 + 25.8 ns during 5000 samples (about 1.38h) roughly.

articleTitle: An on-site calibration device design of time system equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: An on-site time system equipment calibration device based on Beidou-2 satellite system is designed. The method of local taming rubidium clock with the Beidou satellite atomic clock signal is studied. The precise time interval measurement module, the precise voltage generation and control module and the intelligent phase comparison measurement unit are designed. The rubidium clock index in the device is close to the technical index of the cesium clock, and the on-site measurement and calibration of the time system equipment can be realized.

articleTitle: Brain volume prediction based on rs-fMRI time series
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Rs-fMRI time series and volumes of different brain regions possess rich information about the functionality and the structure of the brain, respectively. Recently, artificial neural network emerges as a powerful tool to perform machine learning tasks, which empowers the exploration of the direct relationship between the two. We introduced the deep learning based method and proposed a 1-D convolution operation based deep structure that utilized the spatial and temporal features of the rs-fMRI time series to predict the volumes of different brain regions. The proposed method outperformed the baseline fully-connected neural network, in terms of mean square error. This indicated that the proposed method can utilize temporal and spatial information from rs-fMRI time series better than the fully- connected counterpart.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Rectifying System of Electronic Belt Conveyor Scale Based on an Ultrasonic Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper describes an intelligent rectifying system for an electronic belt conveyor scale, which comprises an ultrasonic sensor, an electric push rod, a correcting roller, an electronic belt conveyor scale frame and a controller. The system detects the offset signal of the weighing belt in real time through an ultrasonic sensor. According to the offset and offset speed of the weighing belt, the controller automatically adjusts the correction amount and the rectification speed in real time to ensure the smooth running of the electronic belt scale, improving the smooth operation of the electronic belt conveyor scale. Meanwhile, this system can effectively solve the frequent fluctuations of tension caused by deviation correction after the weighing belt deviates, thus improving the weighing precision.

articleTitle: Prediction of Brain Functional Connectivity Based on Bayesian Model
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Aiming at the complex spatiotemporal correlation of longitudinal neuroimaging data, this paper proposes a brain function connection prediction method based on spatial correlation and dynamic features. The method uses a conditional autoregressive model to capture the spatial correlation between adjacent voxels and combines it with the dynamic Bayesian model to overcome the existing brain function connection prediction method, considering only time correlation, predicting a single time period, and avoiding simultaneous consider the defects of voxel-level connections. This paper selects the data in the ADNI database to verify the prediction method. The experimental results show that the proposed method can obtain robust and accurate brain function connection prediction results in AD group and control group, thus achieving the implementation of mental illness. Early intervention helps doctors make clinical decisions and prevent serious consequences of mental illness.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Temperature Characteristics of IGBT Switching with Polysilicon Distributed Gate Resistance Effect
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, based on the current crowding effect appearing in the IGBT switching process, the structural model of a high-voltage 4-cell IGBT established. The gate resistance and distributed gate resistance are used to simulate the distribution of three types of gate-bus bars. The temperature distribution of IGBT cells during switching are simulated by Sentaurus TCAD software. The influence of current crowding and the gate resistance on the temperature distribution of IGBT is analyzed. The results show that the reasonable distributed gate resistance has obvious improvement on the uneven temperature distribution caused by current crowding.

articleTitle: Design of Sampling Clock Based on High-Speed Time-Interleaved Sampling System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to meet the stringent requirements of high speed time-interleaved sampling for clock, we take a low phase noise clock chip AD9522 with an internal integrated 2 GHz VCO (voltage controlled oscillator) to provide four sampling clocks with a phase difference of 90° and a frequency of 250 MHz for four alternately sampled analog-to-digital converters. Based on the introduction of the characteristics of AD9522, the design of the sampling clock circuit and the calculation of the parameters of the loop filter are described in detail. The relevant software simulation is used to show that the design meets the system requirements.

articleTitle: Research on CMT Welding Temperature Field Detection Technology Based on Color CCD
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Real-time monitoring of welding temperature field during welding process is important for improving the weld forming quality, At present, the numerical simulation method is mostly used to research on the welding temperature field of Cold Metal Transfer (CMT) process. In this paper, a set of CMT welding temperature field detection system is designed based on color Charge Coupled Device (CCD), the system is mainly consist of optical lens, color CCD, Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) and computer. According to CMT welding current, FPGA controls color CCD acquire weld pool image, the red and green primary color output images of color CCD are used for colorimetric temperature measurement, after calibrating the welding temperature field detection system, the equation for calculating the welding temperature field is obtained by least square fitting. The feasibility of the designed CMT welding temperature field detection system is proved by the experiment of detecting the temperature field variation of weld pool in the basic period of CMT process.

articleTitle: Research on Thermal Failure Mechanism of IGBT Based on Thermal Balance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) has different power consumption-temperature characteristics in different temperature stages. Based on the existing steady-state and transient mathematical models of IGBT, the power consumption-temperature curve of IGBT is obtained by considering the relationship between the internal parameters of the device and the physical constants of the material semiconductor and temperature. It is found that the power consumption-temperature curve increases approximately linearly in the low temperature stage and exponentially in the high temperature stage. The stable point, unstable point and critical point of junction temperature are obtained by solving the IGBT power consumption-temperature curve and heat transfer curve simultaneously, and the thermal failure mechanism of IGBT is analyzed based on the positive feedback relationship between IGBT power consumption and junction temperature at the unstable point. Finally, the experimental verification is carried out.

articleTitle: Battery State-of-Charge Estimation Based on Fuzzy Dual Kalman Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Extended Kalman filter (EKF) algorithm can be used as a model-based approach to estimate the state of charge (SOC) of batteries, and the accuracy of SOC estimation can be affected by the error of battery model. Moreover, a large current or current change leads to a large model error. A fuzzy dual Kalman filter (Fuzzy-DKF) algorithm was proposed to estimate SOC in this paper. Specifically, Thevenin equivalent circuit model was established, and was transformed to autoregressive exogenous (ARX) model, the parameters of ARX model were identified by Kalman filter (KF) algorithm; current and current change were monitored in real time and a fuzzy control system was built to reduce the impact of model error by modifying Kalman gain; EKF algorithm was adopted to estimate SOC. The results indicate that the accuracy of SOC estimation based on Fuzzy-DKF algorithm is better than the accuracy of SOC estimation based on EKF algorithm or dual Kalman filter (DKF) algorithm.

articleTitle: Workspace study of a novel 2R1T arallel mechanism with few degrees of freedom
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: For the industrial manipulator of space tandem mechanism, there are many shortcomings such as poor stiffness and intensity, low repetition accuracy and high energy consumption. In this paper, a 2-RPU/RPS parallel mechanism with 2R1T degrees of freedom is designed based on three less dof active branched chains. The degree of freedom of 2-RPU/RPS parallel mechanism is calculated and verified. According to the workspace solution process based on the boundary numerical search method proposed in this paper, it is proved that the moving platform has a large attitude rotation range of about 80° along the X direction. This paper lays a necessary theoretical foundation for the research and development of multi-axis machining equipment for complex curved workpiece based on parallel mechanism.

Author Keywords: Active branched chain with few degrees of freedom

articleTitle: Degradation Characteristics of Enhancement-Mode Gallium Nitride Cascoded FETs under different DC voltages
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Depletion-mode gallium nitride (GaN) high-electron-mobility transistors (HEMTs) need to connect with an enhancement-mode silicon (Si) MOSFET for cascoded structures in order to achieve normally-off operation. The devices are submitted to electrical overstress to investigate the degradation phenomenon. The results demonstrate that degradation near the rated voltage of enhancement-mode GaN (e-GaN) Cascoded FETs can be a time-dependent process. There is no significant degradation of on-resistance and saturation current after a period of time for devices experienced 320V stress. The electrical characteristics of the devices are measured after 6 days of natural recovery. The on-resistance and saturation current of all devices exhibit reversibility, while the gate/source leakage current is irreversible.

articleTitle: Research on layout optimization of cold chain warehouse center based on SLP method
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Based on the operation process of cold chain logistics center and the relationship between different businesses, this paper plans the existing storage center reasonably. On the basis of SLP method, the basic elements of logistics objects, logistics flow and logistics operation route are analyzed. Make clear the relationship between logistics operation units and non-logistics operation units, use the weighted sum of their comprehensive relations to generate the comprehensive proximity ranking, and determine the area and location of the operation units based on the actual situation and site conditions. Finally, the reasonable layout is obtained by comparing and analyzing with the existing scheme.

articleTitle: A RSA algorithm simulation method using C language
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that data leakage is existed in the Internet era, this paper uses RSA algorithm to encrypt data. First, the basic concepts of cryptography are proposed, and then the basic principles of the RSA algorithm are given. This paper uses C language to simulate RSA algorithm and C/S structure to realize ciphertext transmission. Experimental results show that the RSA algorithm can be used to encrypt data.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Cooperative Positioning Monitoring System Based on Multisource Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to address the special problem of inaccurate positioning environment, we design the system position monitoring system based on multisource data fusion. On completion of the system software and hardware design based on the satellite positioning data and INS positioning data through GPRS upload to server, then install Apache and MySQL to build a server, and implement user interaction with the server through Html and PHP, finally running a C-based console on server, it can solve INS positioning data and satellite positioning data that GPRS upload, and finish the fusion of data based on the accuracy of satellite positioning data. The experimental results show that the algorithm has better positioning accuracy, the system can achieve the target location monitoring function, and the application can view the motion track of the target.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Storage Multi-core System Based on NoC Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The distributed storage multi-core system is designed and implemented based on the NoC (network-on-chip Network) architecture. Compared with the traditional bus-based interconnection architecture, it aims to solve the problem which data processing becomes the bottleneck of the whole system. The system also adopts adaptive routing algorithm, which can flexibly set the priority of data communication according to different applications, and improves the overall data throughput of the system. Finally, by applying this system to the experiment of decoding h. 264 video, it can be verified that the distributed multi-core storage system with NoC architecture can achieve a great improvement in performance.

articleTitle: Optimal bounding box and Grabcut for weakly supervised segmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Weakly supervised semantic segmentation is a challenging problem in computer vision filed. In this paper, we propose a novel method to perform weakly supervised semantic segmentation based on fast regional convolutional neural network (Faster R-CNN) and Grabcut. To deal with the imprecise location of Faster R-CNN detection, we provide a method to optimize the bounding box by building the undirected region adjacency graph on the image to search for the regions which belong to the object outside the bounding box. Then the obtained optimal bounding box is applied to initialize Grabcut algorithm. These accelerate the convergence of the Grabcut algorithm and no extra user interaction is needed. Our approach is validated on the PASCAL VOC 2012 and MSRC-21 datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that our method can provide efficient results in comparison with some state-of-the-arts.

articleTitle: Research on Network of Communication Stations in CC-Link Vibration Friction Welding System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at solving problems of the communication between the master station and slave stations in the control system of vibration friction welding machine, we use CC-link field bus technology to realize the communication network on vibration friction welding machine. The communication network design of vibration friction welding system based on CC-link was carried out, and the communication network of vibration friction welding system with Mitsubishi FX3U PLC as the basic unit, FX3U-16CCL-M as the main station and FX3U-4AD and FX3U-4DA as the slave stations was analyzed and established. The networking principle of CC-Link communication and the networking design process of vibration friction welding system were introduced in detail, including system configuration, parameter setting, program design, experimental results analysis and so on. The results show that the design of CC-Link networking improves the degree on automatic control of the system, enhances the stability of the system, verifies the feasibility of digital-analog communication, and provides a certain preference for the communication research between PLC and host computer.

articleTitle: A new frequency estimation method for real signal in noise
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to suppress the spectrum leakage influence of negative frequency component of real signal on frequency estimation, a novel method is proposed. First, the fast Fourier Transform algorithm is adopted to improve the real time performance.
