In the second stage, the real signal is converted to a complex signal by means of coarse frequency estimation, coarse amplitude estimation and constructing the reference signal, and the spectrum leakage influence can be gradually reduced by an iterative interpolation procedure. The results of simulation testing indicate that the proposed method suppress the spectrum leakage influence and improves the estimation performance. Moreover, the efficacy of the proposed method is validated by the experimental testing on LFMCW radars.

articleTitle: Description and Analyzing of Web Services Composition based on Coloured Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Current formalized description is a key issue for semantic web services. Related works attempt at analyzing and verifying for web service composition with traditional Petri nets. However, Petri nets can only show the flow of process, in this paper we specify basic definitions of CPNs and 4 basic structures of web service described by CPN model. Finally, the author presented CPNs to model web service composition by CPN tools. The feasibility and effectiveness on the CPNs has been verified by simulation result.

articleTitle: Pulmonary Image Segmentation Based On Multifractal Of Local Mode
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In clinical diagnosis of pulmonary diseases by CT images, most rely on the naked eyes and experience of doctors for judgment, with a high misdiagnosis rate. And accurate segmentation and extraction of lung parenchyma and the nodules is the key to the correct analysis of lung disease, this paper is based on the theory of multifractal to segment the CT image by calculating the local mode. Firstly, using the connected region labeling and mathematical morphology method to get rid of the bed in the CT image , blood vessels, and small nodule segmentation to the lungs causing interference information, and then calculate the value of the local area, used to obtain multifractal spectrum of the normalized probability, so as to realize the image segmentation. The experimental results show that the image segmentation by multifractal local mode method can retain more details, make the segmentation more accurate and have good robustness.

articleTitle: Method of Acceleration Sensor Measurement in Full Speed Measurement of Rocket Sled
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: According to the problem of measuring the full speed of rocket sled test by radar, a method of measuring the full speed of rocket sled test based on acceleration sensor is proposed.By means of low-pass filtering and skid processing method, the interference signal influence during the measurement of acceleration sensor is reduced, and the bidirectional zero speed compensation algorithm is adopted to eliminate the error accumulation in the speed calculation process, and the timedomain numerical integration is adopted for the processed acceleration signal. The overall velocity of rocket sled is consistent with that of Eddy current sensor. The acceleration signal after data processing is consistent with the actual operation of the sled. This method is applied to the acceleration signal during rocket sled test, which not only realizes the full speed measurement of rocket sled, but also provides data support for the analysis of the resistance during rocket sled operation.

articleTitle: Performance Test and Result Analysis of College Comprehensive Service Platform App Based on Loadrunner and CCProxy
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the development of big data and mobile intelligent terminal technology, campus App has become the best medium for integrating and sharing school resources and connecting teachers and students. The multi-user concurrency performance of the campus App directly determines experience effect of the users. The article proposes a solution to test campus App performance based on Loadrunner and CCProxy. The solution records the App script through CCProxy proxy mode, uses Loadrunner 11 to simulate the number of virtual users, continuously pressurizes the server, sets the rendezvous point for common transactions, and finally evaluates the performance status of the system.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of the Customer Traffic Statistics Analysis System Based on Wi-Fi Sniffing Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to help arcade shop premises get the information on flow of customers, we designed a customer flow rates' statistical analysis system, based on Wi-Fi sniffing technology. The system uses the Wi-Fi sniffing module to decode the MAC address of the mobile phone. Then it summarizes and analyzes the collected information on the cloud platform. Meanwhile with the function of real-time detection of people flow, this system opened the floodgates wide to us to calculate the information such as the average dwelling time of customer, the trend of customer flowed. The Wi-Fi sniffing module is placed to detect the wireless signal of the mobile phone and determine the customer's location. The above information can be used to realize the data-based operation of offline stores, further than that, optimizing the management of shopping malls.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Instantaneous Acoustic Quality of Automobile Latch Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Aiming at improving the acoustic quality of the latch mechanism of automotive side door, the contact point of the car side door slam with the loudest sound is obtained. In view of the difficulty of obtaining sufficient experimental instantaneous acoustic samples during the door slam process of latch acoustic testing, a method combined with FEM and BEM using ABAQUS and LMS software is utilized skillfully to obtain acoustic samples. The credibility of the simulation samples is verified within an error range smaller than 12%. Finally, a subjective-objective acoustic quality evaluation method and algorithm based on BP neural network is realized in MATLAB. The prediction results in BP neural network are tallied with the real results well. This study provides a reference for the objective evaluation of latch acoustic quality during process of door slam.

articleTitle: Real-Time LOD Rendering of Tire Tracks in Dynamic Terrain
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to meet the need of tire tracks visualization in dynamic terrain simulation, one GPU-based view-dependent continuous level of detail dynamic terrain rendering algorithm is proposed. The terrain deformation algorithm is executed in GPU memory, at the same time the tiled block quad-tree algorithm is used to render the deformed terrain. Different blocks are rendered with different level of detail by reusing a small vertex buffer and index buffer as well as different scale and bias factors. The skirt is added to each block's border to repair the potential cracks between neighboring blocks. The inquiry of the elevation is executed in the shader to collision detection. In the end, the experimental results show that our method is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Model Learning of Robot Inverse Dynamics based on Self-Organizing Map Gaussian Process Regression
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: An accurate inverse dynamics model of robotic systems is key in robotic applications. Analytic inverse dynamics models suffer from uncertainties of physical parameters estimation, some complex frictions and actuator dynamics. In such cases, developing machine learning algorithm to approximate the inverse dynamics model from collected data become a hot research field. In this paper, a novel approach based on Self-Organizing Map Gaussian Process Regression (SOM-GPR) is proposed for modeling inverse dynamics of a robotic arm, which is a combination of the SOM and GPR. In our method, we use the SOM neural network to divide the global GP model into multiple small-sized local GP models. The prediction for a test point is performed by the nearest local GP model. With our approach, we can achieve the accurate modeling of robot inverse dynamics models. The effectiveness of our proposed algorithm has been verified in the experiment. The result of the experiment shows that the combination of two techniques we propose has a better performance over other extensions of GPR applied to learn the inverse dynamics model.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation Method of DDS-based Distributed System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a new reliability evaluation method for effective evaluation of the reliability of DDS-based distributed system according to the characteristics of data publish/subscribe in the system. Firstly it introduces the necessity of evaluation of the reliability of DDS-based distributed system, and points out the shortcomings of reliability evaluation method of the traditional software system. Puts a new reliability evaluation method which is based on the traditional method Considered the complexity of component interaction by combining the characteristics of data publish/subscribe in the system.Finally, this paper proves the correctness of the method by comparing the verification examples.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Feasibility of the Array Invariant-based Source Range Estimation in Deep Sea by Vertical Linear Array
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The array invariant based on conventional beamforming has been proposed for source-range estimation using a horizontal linear array (HLA) or vertical linear array (VLA), with no need for forward model computations. The approach has been demonstrated successfully with experimental data in shallow water. However, it is rarely reported in the deep sea. In this paper, the generalized array invariant is extended to deep-sea environment where the waveguide invariant is variable in range. The method of source localization in deep sea based on array invariant using a VLA has been studied. The feasibility of the array invariant-based source range estimation in deep sea by vertical array is verified by simulation with different source-receiver ranges (3km, 5km, 8km and 12km) in 2000 m water depth. The simulation results show that the method can be effectively applied to deep-sea localization, and the relative error is less than 15%. This method can provide reference for the research of deep-sea localization and deep-sea target recognition.

articleTitle: Research on Wheeled Mobile Robot Positioning Based on EKF Multi-sensor Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper proposes mobile robots suitable for the logistics industry must accurately locate their position and their own pose problems during the SLAM [1] (simultaneous localization and mapping)process, that is, the positioning problem before the front-end frame matching. In this paper, a sensor data fusion localization method based on extended Kalman filter is proposed, which uses ultra-wideband [2] (UWB) and relative positioning odometer [3] (ODOM) sensors make full use of their advantages and make accurate self-positioning, which enables mobile robots to build highly accurate environmental maps in complex indoor environments. The sensor data fusion method based on Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) combines the measurement data of UWB with the measurement data of the odometer to improve the positioning accuracy of the mobile robot while controlling the system cost.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning of Wafer Handling Robot Based on ADAMS Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In view of the need to set different trajectories for wafer handling robot to adapt to the production process, proposed to use computer simulation to run the trajectory of wafer handling robot. The author analysis the kinematics of the robot and established the corresponding mathematical model. The trajectory of the robot is planned for a specific production link. The trajectory is run in ADAMS, and analyzed the result of simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Power Characteristics Matching of Electric Drive Crawler Bulldozer
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: According to the composition of the electric drive system of the electric drive crawler bulldozer, the basic parameters of the main components in the electromechanical transmission system were calculated by using theoretical knowledge. The original and improved electric drive crawler bulldozer were simulated and compared respectively by using ADVISOR simulation software in order to verify the power performance of the improved electric drive crawler bulldozer. The studying result shows that the improved drive motor can meet the load characteristics of the crawler bulldozer under the bulldozing conditions through theoretical analysis and simulation research, and the improved electric drive system can meet the power characteristics of the D320E electric drive crawler bulldozer.

articleTitle: Automatic Video Tracking of Chinese Mitten Crab Using Particle Filter Based on Multi Features
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to know the living habits of Chinese Mitten Crab automatically, we proposed a new computer vision algorithm to track the trajectory of crab in this paper. Particle Filter tracking algorithm is used to predict the target's location and size from the captured video sequences. We proved it is suitable to handle non-Gaussian movement, which meet the movement characteristics of crab movement. In the feature match stage of motion tracking, we propose using multi-features which contains color and contour features to match the target for increasing the tracking stability and robustness. By using the weighting method, the multi-features particle filter (MFPF) combines the color and contour features which could effectively solve the tracking failure problem due to similar color interference, strong light disturbance and deformation of the target. To determine the robustness and accuracy of our algorithm, we have used about 10 minutes video sequences to test our algorithm. The experimental results show that the MFPF is feasible and can be used as an efficient tool to get the pathway of crabs under water to a certain extent with solving the problem of the previous methods.

articleTitle: Study on Grouping Control Strategy of Lithium Batteries
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The single cells in series will show inconsistency during the working process. The inconsistency of the single cells will affect the performance and life of the battery. This paper proposes a new equalization control strategy based on this problem. Divided into two layers, the bottom layer and the top layer, the bottom layer and the top layer use different control strategies, and the bottom and top level control strategies are independent of each other. The bottom layer is a multi-level bridge arm circuit and a single battery in parallel, and the top layer is an equalization mode in which the inductor is used as an energy transfer carrier. Finally, MATLAB was used to build an imitation environment, and the effectiveness of the new control strategy was verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Analytical calculation of fundamental wave and harmonic characteristics for MMC
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) has been widely used in large-scale electrical systems. The harmonic characteristics of MMC are of great concern to the system stability. Analyses on fundamental wave and harmonic characteristics are performed in this article. The result shows that the carrier frequency is essential to the total harmonic distortion of the voltage, and raising the modulation amplitude can increase the fundamental wave, while decrease THD rate. The simulation results of this paper promise to have many practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Intelligent Substation Communication Network Traffic Predicting Based on Improved Elman Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Due to the introduction of a large number of auxiliary monitoring equipment in smart substation, higher requirements are put forward for the performance of substation communication network. At present, there is a lack of effective methods for monitoring and predicting the traffic of substation communication network. In this paper, a communication Network traffic predicting method based on improved Elman neural network has been proposed, according to the characteristics of network communication in intelligent substation. An improved PSO algorithm is proposed to optimize the learning process of Elman neural network. The experimental results show that this method has better convergence and stability than the standard Elman network model, and can obtain higher prediction accuracy. The method proposed in this paper can effectively predict the traffic of substation communication network.

articleTitle: Research on Extraction Optimization Algorithm of Color Stripe Structure Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the 3D measurement image processing, the grating stripe pattern is projected onto the surface of the object to be measured by the colored stripe structure light to add feature information to the object, and the high-precision 3D model is reconstructed. The key problem affecting the reconstruction accuracy is how to extract quickly and accurately of the centerline of the colored stripes in the image. In this research, The image quality of image is susceptible to environmental factors. So an improved algorithm combining color image enhancement and skeleton extraction is proposed. Firstly, the algorithm obtains the component maps of three channels by image enhancement in MATLAB. The histogram equalizes and uniformly distributes the gray values of the three-channel component images and performs color synthesis on the three channels. Finally, the center line of the image is extracted by the skeleton extraction method. Experiments show that compared with the traditional skeleton extraction algorithm, the algorithm has higher extraction precision and robustness, and provides good precision guarantee for subsequent 3D image system measurement.

articleTitle: Smoke video detection based on lightweight convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel method is used to detect smoke from video sequences, which combines the traditional smoke detection algorithm with the current popular lightweight convolutional neural network. The method of combining artificial smoke feature extraction with neural network automatic smoke feature extraction is adopted. The lightweight neural network MobileNet model is reconstructed and trained to solve the problem of smoke detection classification. Compared with the current popular smoke detection algorithm, this method had better real- time performance, improved the smoke detection accuracy effectively and reduced the false alarm rate of smoke detection.

articleTitle: Joint HFaster-RCNN and Bayesian Posterior Probabilities for Pedestrian Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: A novel fusion HOG descriptor and Faster-RCNN (HFaster-RCNN) for pedestrian detection method is proposed. The proposed method generates fine pedestrian candidate regions using fusion saliency map and region proposal network (Saliency RPN). In order to synthesize the complementary advantages of traditional hand-crafted feature method and deep learning, we realized the classifier decision information fusion of Faster-RCNN and HOG feature descriptor by using Bayesian posterior probabilities. Experimental results show that the proposed method has better hit rate compared with single feature extraction method. Furthermore, the detection results on the Caltech pedestrian dataset indicate that the proposed method can achieve state-of-the- art performance compared with the existing pedestrian detection methods. At last, the method is tested on a smart camera of Xilinx Zynq computing platform. Experimental results show that it costs around 0.26 seconds to detect an image and keeps high accurate rate with the network embedded on smart camera.

articleTitle: Optimization of PN Component Sequence Acquisition Algorithm in Telemetry Ranging
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Telemetry ranging technology uses an uplink ranging link that Regenerative PN ranging does. In PN sequence acquisition stage, traditional maximum search algorithm still finds a maximum when only noise signal is input. That will cause a false acquisition. Aiming at that problem, three solutions which add some optimizations to the maximum search algorithm are proposed. The new algorithms greatly reduce the false acquisition probability under the noise only input circumstance. The simulation results further verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. It is recommended to use the maximum-threshold comparison algorithm for the acquisition of component sequence in telemetry ranging.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection of Occlusion Based on Multi-marker method
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Detection of occluded pedestrian in traffic scene is a difficult problem in pedestrian detection. Based on this, this paper proposes a new pedestrian detection method which is different from the traditional sliding window method. This method combines a gaussian mixture model (GMM) with local occlusion pattern capture method based on multi-label learning. This model extracts detection information from a small number of frames for unsupervised learning, each part of the mixed image represents the expectation target found in the image region. At run time, the window most likely to contain a pedestrian will be sampled from the widget and evaluated by a classifier. In the analysis of local occlusion, a group of decision trees are shared by component detectors, and the computation time is reduced by learning and combining the regional correlation. Experimental results show that the combined gaussian mixture model with local occlusion capture method can greatly reduce the computational complexity and provide better recognition performance for pedestrian occlusion.

articleTitle: 3D Measurement using a binocular cameras-projector system with only one shot
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: We propose a two-camera and single-projector three-dimensional scanning system based on the de Bruijn sequence of color stripe pattern, the purpose of which is to reconstruct the three-dimensional model of the object by one scanning method. Compared with the existing methods, the time coding method requires a lot of time, and we directly use the color to encode the image, so that an image can be captured to complete the object reconstruction. In this paper, the two-step method is used. First, the camera is simultaneously calibrated. And then the result of the camera calibration is used to correct the image position of the color stripe pattern. Under the effect of compensating light. Not only do we get excellent camera calibration results, but we also compensate for color deviations caused by external light sources and projector projections, resulting in excellent projector calibration results. Under the action of the dual camera, a more complete scanning degree of the object is obtained, and high-precision measurement can also be implemented.

articleTitle: Design of Robust Intravenous Infusion Monitoring Device
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, a design method of an infusion monitoring device using a 5kg load cell was proposed, and a material object with a monitoring accuracy of 0.1g was fabricated by this method. Usually, the use of load cells to monitor the infusion situation will face a variety of external disturbances. This paper ensured that the correct data was filtered out via the range analysis of the measured values and software filtering, and summed up all kinds of errors that may occur, which made the device have the ability to judge varieties of errors. Besides, the selection of different thresholds in the range was explored so that the device can dynamically adjust the threshold according to different drug solutions, different rate requirements, and different infusion sets. Furthermore, this paper proposed the equation and method of temperature correction. The results show that the proposed design method made the device more practical.

articleTitle: Research on Trend Analysis and Prediction Algorithm Based on Time Series
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: At present, there is an increasing demand for big data analysis in various industries. Big data is characterized by large data scale, long calculation cycle, and high resource performance requirements for distributed computing systems. For the resource performance and state information provided by the distributed computing system of big data, the trend-based time prediction algorithm is used to predict the short-term performance of the resource. We set more weights to track the trend of data change, distinguish the different situations of data increase and decrease, so that the improved hybrid trend prediction algorithm has better performance than the improved one, and effectively improves the accuracy of prediction.

articleTitle: Extracting Community Structures in Complex Networks Based on Discrete Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper studies the problem of complex network community structure extraction, and proposes the DHNN algorithm. This algorithm shows that from the arbitrary initial value, after several iterations, it finally converges to an attractor or a limit loop of length 2, giving the energy of DHNN. The relationship between function and modularity function proves that the stable point of the network corresponds to a very large modular function Q value, and the example verification work is carried out. For the DHNN algorithm proposed in this paper, the simulation experiment is carried out on the actual network. The results show that the eigenvalue eigenvector algorithm of DHNN community structure extraction algorithm Newman has a large Q value. At the same time, the DHNN algorithm does not need to calculate the eigenvalue eigenvectors, and only needs a simple addition multiplication operation to extract the community structure in the network.

articleTitle: A High-Performance Multi-array Accelerator for Large-Scale Floating-Point Matrix Multiplication
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Large-scale matrix multiplication is a fundamental kernel in science and engineering applications. However, existing computing platforms such as CPU, GPU and FPGA suffer from limited performance or excessive power consumption. This paper presents a high-performance and efficient accelerator named MMA for floating-point matrix multiplication based on scaled- out multi-array systolic arrays. A scheduling method is proposed for efficiently performing large-scale matrix-multiplication. Besides, an analytical model is built based on related design parameters to explore and determine the optimal design space. Evaluation results show that the accelerator with 8x8 matrix processing arrays nested with 8x8 systolic array can achieve a maximum performance of 12 TFLOPS and an efficiency of 99% for large-scale matrix multiplication. Compared with NVIDIA TESLA K4O GPU implemented with similar process, the actual performance of MMA is 2.57x of K4O, while the area is only about 58.4% of the latter.

articleTitle: Analysis of Tolerance Value on Torsion Bar and Output Shaft assembly for Automotive EPS
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Torsion bar need to be pressed into output shaft for electrical power steering assembly, but the tolerance value should be determined when designing the torsion bar and output shaft model. There is initial penetration between torsion bar and output shaft finite element after meshing the 3D model, then study and eliminate the penetration, and find the maximum equivalent stress and deformation of X axis is 0 when offset value is -0.077mm after simulation based on different offset value . The tolerance value is calculated based on interfere fit between torsion bar and output shaft which let the torsion bar can not slip when 50Nm external load applied. Verify the analysis result by testing at test bench, and the test result is closed to the analysis result.

articleTitle: Research on A New Knotting Device Based on Knot Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to automatize the knotting operation to meet the requirements of intelligent manufacturing, we take the overhand knot as an example to analyze its forming process. Based on the knot theory, the method of twisting around the rope axis is put forward. A new knotting device consisted of arc edge cam, incomplete hollow gear disk and movable arm gripper is constructed. For the support force of the rope belt, the spatial contour curve of edge cam is constructed by utilizing the B-spline curve and satisfies the forming principle of the overhand knot. Finally, a physical prototype experiment of the new knotting device is carried out. The experimental results show that the new knotting device integrated with knotting method can realize the forming of the overhand knot can be achieved with robustness, also the rope belt in new mechanism moves smoothly in the knotting process.

articleTitle: DWT-based color image encryption using multi-chaotic maps
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper introduces a discrete wavelet transform (DWT)-based color images encryption method by multi-chaotic maps. Three improved one-dimensional (1D) chaotic maps are utilized to produce the keystreams, where the original image and the external secret key are employed to update the initial conditions and parameters of the chaotic systems. The image sub-bands obtained via DWT decomposition are firstly encrypted. In what follows, the image after inverse discrete wavelet transform (IDWT) reconstruction is further diffused in the spatial domain by the keystreams to strengthen the security of the cryptosystem. Experimental results and security analysis show the feasibility, validity and security of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm of Laser Cutting Path for Multi-contour Sheet Metal Parts
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and quality of laser cutting of sheet metal, we propose a new selection method of contour processing points in this paper. Besides the distance between two points, this method also considers the influence of the processing sequence and position distribution of contour on the selection of processing points. First, the improved firefly algorithm was adopted to optimize the processing sequence of contour. Then, combined with the location of the central point of contours, the optimal processing points of contours were obtained by local search. Finally, a complete processing path was formed. In addition, the principle and realization of the algorithm are introduced in this paper. The simulation results showed that the path was shortened by 2.6% compared with genetic algorithm, and was shortened by 5.7% compared with the nearest neighbor rule, which obviously achieved further optimization.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Aided Assessment Technology Based on Three-Dimensional Design Achievements
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the development of smart grid and information technology, three-dimensional design technology has been further applied in power grid engineering. There are great differences between three-dimensional design and traditional design in work mode, design process and output of results. New changes will also take place in the content, process and method of Engineering Evaluation. Traditional evaluation methods cannot fully meet the requirements of evaluation of three-dimensional design results. The data content and characteristics of three-dimensional design results are analyzed, and the technology of information extraction of three-dimensional design results is studied. A method of evaluating three-dimensional design results of power grid engineering with computer-aided technology is proposed. The method is verified by practical engineering. The results show that the method effectively improves the efficiency and quality of evaluation.

articleTitle: Video Target Detection Algorithm Based on Cuckoo Search and Gaussian Background Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the establishment and updating of traditional Gaussian mixture background model, learning rate and foreground threshold determine the accuracy of background model and the rate of detecting target to some extent. However, their values are not easy to determine. For the above problems, this paper proposes an improved video target detection algorithm based on Gaussian mixture background model and cuckoo search algorithm. This algorithm used cuckoo search algorithm to find the appropriate learning rate and foreground threshold. Experimental results show that this method not only improves the integrity of detection effect of moving target, but also enhances the accuracy of background description.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent monitoring system for roof abscission layer
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: According to the characteristics of coal seam mining, an intelligent monitoring system of coal mine abscission is designed. The intelligent monitoring device includes micro laser ranging module, an integrated protective fixture, wireless transmission module, DC module, base station and upper computer software. In this paper, the structure of the system and the arrangement of measuring points are presented, the hardware and software design of the system used to accurately measure the displacement of roof abscission layer is introduced in detail, and the alarm threshold of roof abscission layer displacement is analyzed. The test results show that the system can monitor the displacement of the roof separation layer in real time.

articleTitle: Degradation of Series Diodes Under High Voltage
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, the degradation characteristics of the series diodes under DC high voltage operation are investigated. Five series connected diodes are operated at a reverse bias voltage of 1500V. The influence of the DC high voltage on the diode parameters is analyzed after the I-V characteristic test. Finally, an annealing experiment is performed on a diode that stressed under DC high voltage. The results show that the high voltage will introduce defects into the diodes, which leads to the increases of the recombination current and the ideality factor. The degradation degree of five diodes is basically the same. For the annealing experiment, the recoverability of defects can be observed.

articleTitle: Research Progress of MIMO UWB Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The main technical parameters and the decoupling technology of MIMO UWB antenna are summarized, respectively. The development trend of UWB antenna is prospected. Under the background that 5G will be commercially available and 6G will be deeply studied, MIMO UWB antenna will be widely used in the field of mobile communication due to its advantages of broadband, high frequency spectrum utilization, high isolation and good diversity characteristics.

articleTitle: The Analysis of User Tags Recommended Model Based on Selection Association Rule
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Social networking allows users to personalize the vocabulary of network resources. Therefore, social networks have become a representative scenario of social tagging systems. In micro-blogging networks, users can personalize their own labels to show the individual social attributes. This paper analyzes the micro-blog user data, summarizes the characteristics of the micro-blog user tags, and for the lack of personalized labels for existing models used in microblogging scene, we propose an improved association rule model based on the recommendation of the selection. On this basis, the microblogging users selected tags is analyzed, the correlation of user labels is calculated, and finally associated personalized labels are recommended to users. The model can be improved determined while ensuring the diversity of recommendations by comparing the experimental results.

articleTitle: One Design Scheme of Control System of Intelligent Gunpowder - free Fireworks
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Traditional pyrotechnics and fireworks require combustion and extreme levels of heat to operate. This makes them incredibly dangerous. In response to this phenomenon, the author developed a smart material fireworks machine that uses metal powder as the object of spraying. This article details the hardware selection and program development process of the main functional modules. The hardware selection and the process of program development of the main functional modules are introduced in detail. The speed regulation module of DC brushless electric machine is designed and the PID control algorithm is adopted to realize the digital control of the spraying height of the fireworks. A close-range wireless communication system based on 2.4G is designed to realize multi-machine online intelligent control of fireworks. Finally, the intelligent control system is tested online. The results show that the fireworks machine has high anti-interference ability and can effectively receive communication information; meanwhile, the system runs stably and reliably. For this reason, the fireworks machine can well replace the traditional disposable cold firework barrel and become the standby of stage performance equipment.

articleTitle: Determination of space-charge distribution under ultra-high-voltage direct current transmission lines based on air filtration method
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the rapid implementation of ultra-high-voltage direct current (UHVDC)-voltage beyond 800 kV-transmission in China, engineers are paying increased attention to the electrical environment of the lines, with major focus on electrical phenomena such as ground electric field, ion current density, magnetic field, audible noise, and radio interference. The electric field, which is the superposition of electrostatic fields generated by the surface charge on the conductor and the space charge in the surrounding air, is significantly influenced by space-charge distribution. Electrical environment tests of UHVDC transmission lines show that when large amounts of charged particles are suspended in the air, there is a substantial increase in the ground electric field. In this study, the air filtration method was used to measure the distribution of the space charge under UHVDC transmission lines in order to determine its influence on the ground electric field and to decide the design parameters for UHVDC transmission lines. The measurement error of the air filtration method is small, and the measurement position is not restricted. Further, compared with other methods, the air filtration method is more convenient and suitable for measuring the space charge caused by UHVDC transmission lines.

articleTitle: A low complexity FPGA implementation of uplink SCMA decoder
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Sparse code multiple access (SCMA) is a novel non- orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) scheme to face 5G communication, adopting message passing algorithm (MPA) to demodulate users’ message in the receiver. When LOG-MPA transfers MPA into log-domain, the expansion contains correction term suffering complicated calculation. In that case, a FPGA implementation Scheme is proposed on the basis of Maclaurin series, which retains correction term and has fewer iterations. The Simulation results show that proposed scheme can obtain closed BER performance to LOG-MPA, while possessing a lower complexity. Finally, FPGA verification on Vivado HDL platform proves the design has complete function and can be applied in practice.

articleTitle: Construction of ruled surface based on MATLAB software
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In MATLAB software, under the condition of knowing the ruled surface equation, knowing the two leads control vertices and knowing the two leads data point, this paper constructs the ruled surface model by using the basic theory of computer-aided geometric design and B-spline curves and surfaces, realizes the interactive design between the surface construction and the computer, and gives the corresponding example. The construction of ruled surface provides a prerequisite for subsequent model-based optimization analysis problems.

articleTitle: Research on Panorama Reconstruction Technique of UAV Aerial Image Based on Improved ORB Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Classic ORB (oriented FAST and rotated BRIEF) algorithm usually extracts feature points globally, which will result in more false feature match pairs and longer computation time. In this paper, an improved ORB algorithm is proposed to reconstruct the panorama of aerial images. First, phase correlation method is used to obtain overlapping area between to-be-stitched image and reference image, and improved ORB is adopted to detect and describe feature points on overlapping regions. Second, K-nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm is utilized to match feature points roughly, and false matching points are removed by Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC) algorithm. Finally, the improved weighted average fusion algorithm is adopted to eliminate ghosting, while realizing the seamless splicing of UAV images. Experimental results show that, compared with SIFT and classic ORB, the algorithm proposed in this paper can obtain higher registration accuracy, and also significantly improve the stitching accuracy and efficiency of UAV aerial images.

articleTitle: Design of Buck Synchronous rectification Converter and Optimization Based on Reliability Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: DC-DC converter is a basic part of modern high-frequency switching power supplies. Detailed circuit design can improve system reliability. This paper presents the detailed design steps and reliability evaluation process of the Buck Synchronous rectification converter. Through reliability analysis, the most fragile devices in the converter are found, and the causes of device failure are analyzed and optimized.

Author Keywords: Buck Synchronous rectification converter design reliability

articleTitle: A diversity technique of anti-multipath based on STBC for pseudolite systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the design of indoor high-precision positioning systems, the multipath effect is the main problem impacting the performance of the pseudolite positioning system. For the indoor propagate environment, multipath fading serious, signal losing frequently, signal to noise ratio cutting down. In order to reduce the multipath effect and improve the relevant capture characteristics of the receiving loop, we presents a technical scheme adding STBC (Space-time Block Coding) to conventional pseudolite systems. Therefore the dual-transmitting and single-receiving antenna (2Tx, 1Rx) is adopted in this scheme. Meanwhile the space-time encoding based on STBC is used at the transmitter, and channel frequency estimating, space time decoding based on MLD (Maximum Likelihood Decoding) and EGC (Equal-Gain Combining) are used at the receiver. The simulation results show that the scheme can reduce the impacts of multipath effect and increase the SNR (Signal-to-Noise Ratio) of received signals, so as to improve the positioning accuracy of the pseudolite receiver.

articleTitle: A Anti-collision Algorithm Based On Checking Group And Collision Tree
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Aiming at the information Collision generated by multiple tags simultaneously responding to the reader under the condition of tag density in RFID, it is proposed that an anticollision algorithm bases on checking group and collision tree(CGCT) in this paper. The parity check is used to take the eigenvalues of tag ID, and the tags are grouped according to the eigenvalues, and the collision bit information is determined by using the feature information, so as to reduce the number of reader queries and shorten recognition time. Through theoretical analysis and simulation, it is concluded that the total slots and communication traffic used by the CGCT algorithm are obviously superior to other deterministic algorithms in the case of tag density, with relatively high recognition efficiency.

articleTitle: A Similarity Metric for Face Verification
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of similarity Metric, the method of combining Mobilenetv2 and SSIM is used to solve the problem that Mobilenetv2 is inaccurate in the similarity measure of different faces. We used the face dataset provided by the University of Essex, UK to test and the effectiveness of the method has been verified.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of anode power supply for ECRH
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: As a key component of electron cyclotron resonance heating (ECRH) on Tokomak, cyclotron is very sensitive to voltage fluctuation of anode power supply (APS). In view of the APS module working in the discontinuous current mode (DCM), each stage of the APS module has been analyzed in detail. Therefore, the small signal model of the single module has been established. On this basis, the equivalent mathematical model of the APS has been established. The parameters of the PI controller have been designed to ensure that the APS has the characteristics of small overshoot and strong anti-interference ability. The simulation results show that the PI controller not only has a good regulating effect on the steady-state output, but also balances the requirements of overshoot and dynamic response speed when the power supply modulates the output.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of General Control Load System for Sport Aircraft Simulator
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Control load system is an important equipment of flight simulator. The basic requirement of the controller is that it can control the model force needed for output and good dynamic characteristics. In this paper, the mathematical model of the control load system is studied. In order to solve the problem of poor universality and difficult parameter tuning of the existing control load system, a control algorithm of flight simulator general control load system based on the combination of PID control algorithm and BP neural network is proposed. The algorithm is called PIDNN algorithm. This paper introduces the arithmetic principle and weight updating method of PIDNN, and designs the controller and chooses the parameters according to the PID neural network. The system model is built with MATLAB/SIMULINK and the simulation experiment is carried out. The simulation results show that the controller based on the PIDNN algorithm has excellent performance. Through the control algorithm, the feedback feel of the output is more accurate and more versatile, which frees the developer from the trouble of poor consistency of parameter setting and control quality. It provides a solution for the design of general control load system controller of small aircraft simulator.

articleTitle: Segmentation of ice accretion image based on infrared thermal wave detection technology
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: An algebraic relationship between the gray value of the output image of the infrared thermal imager and the actual surface temperature of the measured object is illustrated. Combined image segmentation technology, many studies on ice accretion are introduced. Based on Euclidean distance threshold of gray value sequence, a simple and efficient image segmentation algorithm is presented. Infrared thermography sequence with a sample of iced aluminum plate is obtained by the flash excitation thermal wave non-destructive testing station. Then the obtained infrared thermography sequence is taken as examples to show that the proposed algorithm can achieve image segmentation. The Otsu algorithm are employed for comparison. A quantitative index to evaluate the effect of image segmentation is also proposed. The image with better segmentation effect has smaller value of the presented index. Through the infrared thermography sequence experiment, the presented algorithm has the better performance than Otsu algorithm. The proposed algorithm can express more accurate results with less data.

articleTitle: Fast Recognition of Infrared Targets Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Deep learning is a problem in the field of infrared target detection. The main reason is that infrared data has less information. Therefore, traditional detection algorithms have lower detection speed and detection accuracy. In this paper, we mainly propose a fast detection algorithm based on YOLOv3. Due to the real-time nature of YOLOv3 needs to be improved, we merged the improved Mobilenetv2 and YOLOv3 to get a new network structure. Experiments on the standard target detection data set show that the network parameters of the new network are only 30% of the original network, and the detection speed is increased by 3 times. At the same time, the mAP is also improved. Through the experiments on the infrared dataset, we get the following test results: the detection speed of the new constructed network structure can reach 11ms/f, and in good weather conditions, mAP can also reach 76%. This indicates that the network structure proposed in this paper can achieve better results in the fast recognition of infrared.

articleTitle: Adaptive median filtering algorithm based on effective density of window edge
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of insufficient window selection and computational complexity of adaptive median filtering algorithm, this article proposes an adaptive median filtering algorithm based on effective density of window edge. Firstly, the algorithm determines the window size according to the effective pixel density at the edge of the window.; After that, taking the median of the effective pixels in the filtering window to reduce the interference of noise pixels and improve the quality of image filtering. The experimental results show that compared with the original adaptive median filtering algorithm, the complexity of the algorithm is significantly reduced, the denoising effect is more ideal, and the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) value is increased by 2.7366 Db on average.

articleTitle: Development of Press-pack IGBT Chip for good SOA Capability
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, the advantages of press-pack IGBT in DC circuit breaker are introduced. According to the requirement of press package for IGBT chip, a cell structure with field oxide in active region was designed, and the optimal value of the field oxide length was obtained. The static and dynamic characteristics and UIS capability of IGBT with three different field-stop layers were simulated, and the final field-stop layer distribution was determined. The fabricated press-pack IGBT chip has good SOA capability.

articleTitle: Application of FastICA Algorithm in Physical Layer Security Communication System based on Artificial Interference
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In view of the security threat to the information transmission from the wireless communication system, this paper proposes a secure transmission scheme, which sends the artificial interference signal at the same time that the source node sends the secret information. In order to effectively extract the secret signal from the mixed signal by using the prior knowledge of the artificial interference signal, this paper proposes to apply the FastICA algorithm to the separation of the mixed signal and the extraction of the secret signal. Besides, a simple and easy artificial interference signal is designed for the QPSK modulation system to verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme is verified by MATLAB simulation of the bit error rate and the mean square error (MSE) of the separated QPSK signals.

articleTitle: Application of ABAQUS Secondary Development Platform in TC4 Alloy Cutting Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: To solve the problem that the ABAQUS software is complicated to set up, the operation engineering is cumbersome and the workload is large, proposed a secondary development study of ABAQUS based on Python language. Taking the cutting of TC4 alloy as an example, studied the effects of different cutting speeds on the generation frequency and pitch of sawtooth chips. Controlled the modeling process of ABAQUS by writting kernel scripts in the Python language, and implemented parameterized input to the modeling process. The research results show that the ABAQUS secondary development research based on Python language can complete the cutting simulation process of two-dimensional titanium alloy, which greatly improves the efficiency of titanium alloy cutting simulation.

articleTitle: Positive kinematics solution of a six-degree-of- freedom parallel platform based on neural network algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Based on the traditional numerical iterative algorithm, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the structure of the six-degree-of-freedom parallel platform. The initial value of the approximate solution is obtained, and then the iterative method is used to obtain a satisfactory kinematics positive solution.

articleTitle: Design of GPS Receiver Low Noise Amplifier Based on PHEMT
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to realize the high sensitivity of the GPS receiving system, this paper implemented the design and simulation of GPS receiver low noise amplifier based on Advanced Design System (ADS) by using Agilent's low noise amplifier chip ATF54143. The transistor is Pseudomorphic HEMT. The matching circuit of the design adopts lumped parameter network matching and stability optimization design adopts adding negative feedback circuit. The results show NF <; 2 dB, signal gain > 16 dB, input standing wave ratio <; 2, output standing wave ratio <; 1.5 in the 1.47 GHz to 1.65 GHz frequency range by experimental simulation.

articleTitle: Theory of Ultra-Wideband Long-Distance Fiber Communication System Using A Chaotic Laser
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: A theoretical model of ultra-wideband (UWB) fiber communication system is presented via coupling a chaotic UWB laser transmitter, a modulator, an optical fiber channel and a receiver. The effects of the group velocity dispersion and self-phase modulation on the chaotic carrier and the information signal are analyzed theoretically. It can be found that the group velocity dispersion results in the simultaneous phase shifts of the chaotic signal and the information signal, which can expand the pulse shape. The self-phase modulation results in the chaotic signal and information signal generating equal amounts of new frequency components. Influences of modulation amplitude, modulation rate, fiber length, nonlinear coefficient and noise on a long-distance high-rate chaotic UWB fiber communication are discussed in detail. The results are in line with theoretical expectations. It is proved that the long-distance high-speed chaotic ultra-wideband fiber communication is possible.

articleTitle: Efficient Updates in Erasure-Coded Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Vertical array codes are widely used in erasure-coded storage systems due to their optimized update complexity and prominent coding performance. However, in actual data center, the update performance of the storage system is often limited by the cross-rack bandwidth. We propose a new update algorithm that aims to mitigate cross-rack traffic caused by data updates in distributed storage based on vertical array codes. Our proposed algorithm mainly contains three parts: (i) node grouping, which matches and combines the data nodes by comparing the associations between the nodes; (ii) intra-rack aggregation, which reduces the traffic by intra-rack aggregation of the relevant data blocks; (iii) intra-rack update, which converts a portion of cross-rack transfer into an intra-rack transmission. We conduct experiments and present the performance comparison with multiple vertical array codes. Our experimental result shows that it can significantly reduce cross-rack traffic generated by data updates and enhance system throughput.

articleTitle: Development of Integrated Geotechnical Safety Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a geological disaster monitoring system based on data fusion algorithm. In a monitoring system consisting of multiple sensors, the target is monitored at the same sampling rate at the same time, and the collected measured values are expanded and then combined with the direct measured values to form a new system. The Kalman filtering algorithm and the extended Kalman filtering algorithm can obtain the centralized fusion and fusion estimation algorithm of the system. Using this algorithm, the state value of the current time can be combined with the measured value of the current time to obtain a state estimate for the next time.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Production and Publishing Technology of 3D Illustrated Part Catalog
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to improve the timeliness and accuracy of construction machinery maintenance and spare parts service, a distributed production and publishing method for product illustrated part catalog based on service model hierarchical tree is proposed. According to the product information obtained by system integration, the product SBOM and service model are constructed; Drawing on the high-level architecture theory of distributed simulation standards, the publishing task is decomposed and collaboratively published by multiple computers. Compared with other methods, this method improves the efficiency of making and publishing illustrated part catalog and the accuracy of data, realizes the release of "same-source data with multiple formats". The proposed method is illustrated by an example on a typical construction machinery grader.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Fuzzy Adaptive Control of PWM Rectifier in Synchronous Coordinate
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the double closed-loop control of three-phase PWM rectifier in synchronous rotating coordinate system, the voltage control usually adopts linear PI control, which cannot reflect its nonlinear nature. In this paper, a fuzzy adaptive control method is used to adjust PI control parameters online by using fuzzy rule table to meet the requirements of different conditions for setting control parameters, thus achieving good dynamic and static performance. Compared with traditional PI control, fuzzy adaptive control is proved to be superior.

articleTitle: Design of a Web-based Electronic Pulling System for Manufacturing Workshop
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: According to the requirements of material pulling, a web-based electronic pulling system (EPS) is designed for IC manufacturing workshop. Material pulling in the EPS is implemented by means of browser/server architecture and web technology. System architecture, database and function modules of the EPS are discussed in detail. EPS in this paper can effectively improve the work efficiency of production line and avoid the suspension of the production line due to lack of materials.

articleTitle: H∞ state feedback controller design for discrete-time 2D switched systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper investigates the state feedback robust H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> stabilization problem for a class of discrete time 2D(two- dimensional) switched systems represented by the Fornasini- Marchesini (FM) model. First, sufficient conditions for the asymptotically stable and weighted H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> disturbance attenuation performance of the underlying system are derived via the common Lyapunov function method. Furthermore, based on the obtained results, state feedback controller is proposed to guarantee that the resulting closed-loop system is asymptotically stable and has a prescribed disturbance attenuation level γ. All results are expressed in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMI). The effectiveness of this method is verified by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Optimal design of flash thermal excitation in infrared nondestructive testing system
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The uniform illumination of the flash lamp has a great influence on the results of infrared thermal wave non-destructive testing. Based on the irradiance theory, this paper deals with an optical model which can describe the surface irradiance of a parabolic when it is illuminated by a three-dimensional flash array. The angle between each flash and the optical axis is a variable, and the irradiance distribution function for the curved target surface and the objective function for characterizing the uniformity of the target surface irradiance are constructed. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is used to optimize the position of each flash, and get the optimal coordinates of each bulb in the flash array. The irradiance simulation is performed by Tracepro software to verify the feasibility of the design. The results show that the optimized three-dimensional flash array produces a uniform irradiance distribution on the curved target surface.

articleTitle: Research on Several Carrier Synchronization Algorithms for VDE-SAT System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The VHF Data Exchange System (VDES) is upgraded on the basis of the AIS system and is divided into a terrestrial VDE-TER system and a satellite VAT system. Synchronization is critical for satellite links. This paper introduces the characteristics of VDE-SAT channel, and studies several data-assisted carrier synchronization algorithms based on the channel characteristics, finally simulates their performance, then gives the right choice according to different needs.

articleTitle: New Evidential Reasoning Approach Based on Multiple Attribute Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: A new approach is developed for dealing with seriously conflicting evidence especially when the information quality is relatively low resulting from sensors' poor identification performance. The approach combines MADA and the Dempster- Shafer theory of evidence (DST) to deal with the interval uncertainties or local ignorance. A belief interval matrix is firstly constructed, and then an objective programming model is established to obtain the attribute weights. Thus the alternatives can be ranked by using the weighted correlation projection of alternative onto optimum solution. Our proposed method can sufficiently utilize the objective information of alternatives, and at the same time meet the subjective requirements of the decision makers as much as possible. A typical example is given to test the proposed method against some existing methods, and the result shows its superior and practicality, as well its effectiveness of making the decision problem much simpler especially in the case of combining evidence with high conflict information given by “bad” evidences.

articleTitle: Automatic Lane Change Model under Uncertainty of Vehicle Motion in Blind Zone
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the purpose of improving the accuracy of vision-based lane change assist system (LCAS), automatic lane change model under uncertainty of vehicle motion in blind zone (BZ) is researched. Firstly, we propose RGBD-flownet, which fused monocular depth network, ego-motion estimation and flownet. They are coupled by scenario reduction and learned in an end-to-end manner. Secondly, lane change decision database is built, which categorize the driving environment based on the observation grid and propose different lane change behavior to handle the different scenarios. Thirdly, optimal trajectory generation model for lane change in a Frenet Frame is proposed, which combile different lateral and longitudinal cost functionals for lane change as well as to mimic human-like driving behavior. Lastly, we compare experienced driver and the proposed automatic lane change model in the same scenarios. It is showed that the proposed model is able to handle complicated lane change scenarios.

articleTitle: Single-source dual-frequency laser coherent detection for high-speed moving targets
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The maximum measurement speed of the single- frequency laser coherent detection system is limited. Hence, a single-source dual-frequency laser coherent detection method for high-speed moving targets is proposed in this paper. Two different frequency probes are generated by using the frequency shift method, and the dual-frequency signal light is combined with the dual-frequency local oscillator to obtain a multiorder component containing the target information. The relationship between the frequency difference, the detector bandwidth, and the maximum detectable speed of the system is given. The spectrum extraction method of the mixing components at different speed intervals is discussed. The feasibility of this method to improve the maximum detectable speed of the system is verified through simulation analysis. This work provides a theoretical basis for the design of laser coherent detection systems for high-speed moving targets.

articleTitle: Study on Storage Reliability Assessment and Prediction Method of Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Based on the mathematical statistics theory, this project presents a complete storage reliability assessment and prediction method of standardized data collection, life prediction model selection and parameter calculation, single model conformance verification and multi-model goodness of fit test, hence, storage reliability assessment and prediction guideline is developed. Besides, storage reliability evaluation and prediction procedure has been prepared, which can make full use of and mine the storage history data and solve the problem of reliability assessment and prediction for multiple batches storage.

articleTitle: Design of Vehicle Controller Test Program Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the design process, the vehicle controller often has electromagnetic compatibility, that is, EMC problem. Vector has complete software and hardware testing tools, but its price is high, and it is less practical for the controller development stage. In this paper, the test system for testing the EMC problem of the controller is written by LabVIEW, which is widely used and widely developed. The Kavser is used as a diagnostic tool instead of CANanalyzer. This set of test systems is low cost, easy to develop, and able to meet the needs, providing controllers with new options.

articleTitle: Suppressed MT static effect by two wavelet threshold criteria
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the Magnetotelluric sounding (MT), due to the electrical in-homogeneities of the small near-station conductor on surface, static effect are usually caused. In order to suppress this effect, the wavelet threshold is adopted. First, we decomposed the MT data with wavelet coefficients and then used threshold method to reconstruct. The reconstructed signal can effectively suppress the static effect of the MT data. The selection of threshold criterion is the key to suppress the static effect by wavelet. In this paper, two threshold criteria (DT and ST) of the wavelet processing the MT data are compared. The results show that the two threshold methods have certain effects on suppressing static effect.

articleTitle: An improved normalized mutual information variable selection algorithm for neural networks
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, normalized mutual information feature selection (NMIFS) and tabu search (TS) are integrated to develop a new variable selection algorithm for neural networks. NMIFS is applied to select influential variables that contribute to the output variable, and avoids selecting redundant variables by calculating mutual information. TS based strategy is designed to prevent NMIFS from falling into local optimal situation. The proposed algorithm performs the variable selection by combining entropy information, mutual information, and validating error information of neural networks. Therefore, the algorithm proposed in this paper has more advantages than previous mutual information based variable selection algorithms. Several simulation datasets with different scale, correlation and noise are implemented to compare the performance of the proposed algorithm with several classical algorithms. The experiments show that developed algorithm present better model accuracy with fewer variables selected, compared to other state-of-art methods.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of 4 μm InGaAs/AlAsSb Quantum Cascade Lasers on InP Substrate
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of InGaAs/AlAsSb QCLs, the simulation of In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.53</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.47</sub>As/AlAs<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.56</sub>Sb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.44</sub> QCLs on InP substrate are presented and analyzed. Based on the theory of carrier transition in an injector/3-level/extractor system, the conduction band diagram of InGaAs/AlAsSb QCLs is simulated and the effect of the inject layer thickness on the gain property and characteristic temperature are discussed. The results illustrate that the emitting wavelength λ blueshifts along with the increase of the inject layer thickness. And when the injection barrier width is 2.3 nm, the λ of In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.53</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.47</sub>As/AlAs<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.56</sub>Sb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.44</sub> QCLs is around 4μm and the characteristic temperature is up to 140 K, which is in good agreement with experimental results. This work confirms the great potential of InGaAs/AlAsSb materials for the realization of efficient mid-infrared wavelength QCLs and provides a new way to design these devices.

articleTitle: Research on Helix Theory of Parallel 6-DOF Motion Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, the helix theory is applied to the theoretical analysis and formula derivation of the hydraulic six- degree-of-freedom parallel platform for flight simulator. The expression of the forward and inverse solutions of the helical motion equation of the platform's acceleration and velocity under the known engineering conditions is given. The development prospect of the six-degree-of-freedom parallel platform is analyzed based on the consideration of engineering practicability and feasibility. And some useful conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: A Bayesian network version of TRACEr for human reliability analysis of the space launch mission
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This study applied the Technique for Retrospective and Predictive Analysis of Cognitive Errors (TRACEr) to the analysis of the space launch mission. The analysis is consisted of the following two main stages: the identification of human errors in the space launch task context with the TRACEr and the quantification of human error probability (HEP) with a Bayesian network (BNN) based extension of the TRACEr. In the first analysis stage, thirty-seven mishap reports of the Chinese space launch activity are collected and analyzed. Based on the analysis results, the structure of the BNN is determined.
