In the second analysis stage, with incorporating the experts' judgements, the HEP of the task in space launch activity is produced. Also, the sensitivity analysis has been conducted and the most significant influencing factors on human errors in space launch mission have been determined.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Dynamic Analysis of Reciprocating Compressor Considering Different Clearance
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The dynamic model of reciprocating compressor was established, and then it's dynamic behavior with different clearance was studied. The effect of clearance is modeled by elastic damped internal force to establish collision contact relationship. The dynamic simulation of reciprocating compressor under different crankshaft speeds and different clearance is carried out respectively. From the simulation results, it can be seen that the dynamic behavior of reciprocating compressor is greatly affected by different clearance and crankshaft speed. The number and time interval of two large contact collisions are directly related to crankshaft speed. Clearance shapes have little effect on two large collision frequencies and collision intervals. The Lyapunov exponent is used to study the nonlinear characteristics of the system. The results show that chaos occurs when the system contains different clearance.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Fusion for Arbitrary-scale Image Super-resolution
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Convolutional neural network (CNN)-based single image super-resolution (SR) methods have achieved superior performance on some discrete scale factors. Majority CNN-base methods only work for some integer scale factors, such as 2, 3, and 4. Meta-SR method manages to work for more discrete scale factors, such as 1.1, 1.2, etc. However, the scale factors for SR should be arbitrary in practical applications. To extend CNN-based SR methods to an arbitrary scale, in this paper, we propose a multi-scale fusion method for arbitrary-scale SR (MSFASR). In our MSFASR, we first input a low-resolution (LR) image into an existing SR model to generate two different high-resolution (HR) images. Then we downscale/upscale HR images to predict the SR results with target resolution. By exploring scale factor preference, we combine the SR results to get the final SR image. Experimental results with Meta-SR method demonstrated that the MSFASR method could extend CNN-based SR method from discrete to continuous scale and achieve good SR performance on arbitrary scales.

articleTitle: Vehicle Pose Detection and Application Based on Grille Net
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, autonomous driving technology has also received widespread attention. Among them, the vehicle's pose information provides important information for automatic driving decision and vehicle active safety. To solve this problem, this paper proposes to use the deep learning method to improve the traditional pose network and use the random area connection network to reduce the difficulty of vehicle orientation detection. In order to improve the performance of the random area connection network, this paper innovatively proposes raster convolution and designs a grid network based on raster convolution. Experiments were performed on the famous autopilot data set KITTI, achieving an average angular similarity of 89.12% and an average similarity of 87.32%. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional pose detection method, the proposed method has better robustness and detection effect.

articleTitle: Push-Push VCO using Tunable Differential Bandpass Filter based on SIW Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel push-push voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) using the tunable differential bandpass filter (BPF) based on substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) technology is proposed. Firstly, the tunable differential BPF with a high Q factor value, improved stopband suppression and differential configuration is used as the parallel feedback component to provide differential outputs in the design of the push-push VCO which can reduce the phase noise of the VCO. In addition, the fundamental signal suppression and second harmonic enhancement can be obtained simultaneously. Furthermore, with the suppression of the common mode (CM), the push-push VCO can operate at a phase difference of 180° mode without using any phase shifter which can prevent the deterioration of the phase noise. To demonstrate the hypothesis, we designed a push-push VCO based on differential SIW BPF and simulated it. The proposed push-push VCO has the phase noise of −138.8 ~ −150.7 dBc/Hz at the frequency offset of 1 MHz within the two tuning range of 23.76 ~ 23 98 GHz and 24.1~24.32 GHz.

articleTitle: Radar Coherent Detection for Highly Maneuvering Targets based on LRT-TDSFT
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In recent years, target detection has drawn increasing attention in the field of radar signal processing. This paper addresses the radar coherent integration problem for detecting highly maneuvering targets with jerk motion. A novel method based on location rotation transform (LRT) and threedimensional scaled Fourier transform (TDSFT), namely LRT- TDSFT, is proposed in this paper. In this method, the linear range migration (LRM) is first eliminated by LRT. Then, the linear Doppler frequency migration (LDFM) and quadratic Doppler frequency migration (QDFM) are accurately estimated via the newly proposed TDSFT. Analysis shows that, the LRT- TDSFT achieves satisfactory detection performance while keeping acceptable computational complexity. Finally, both simulations and real data experiments are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Effective orifice area measurement of artificial heart valve based on image processing
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Artificial heart valves must be tested and evaluated by in vitro hemodynamic performance from development to clinical application. Effective orifice area(EOA) is one of the important indicators. At present, EOA measurement method mainly relies on manually depicting the contour of the valve opening and calculating it by software. In this paper, a method for measuring the EOA of the artificial heart valve based on image processing is proposed to improve the measurement efficiency of the EOA of the artificial heart valve and solve the problem of low automation and high manual intervention of the traditional method. The morphological image processing can effectively remove the bright noise of the stainless steel bracket and the orifice shaded portion; the region growing algorithm can well segment the open shadow portion. The results show that the method can accurately measure the EOA of artificial heart valves of different specifications, and provide data support for analyzing the relationship between opening area, flow rate and transvalvular pressure difference.

articleTitle: An uncertain multi-fingered robot host system based on parallel LM and multiprocessor
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Due to the nonlinearity and complexity of uncertain multi-finger robot, the ordinary host system is difficult to control effectively. An uncertain multi-finger robot host system based on multiprocessor (MP) and LM algorithm was proposed, which improves the system responsiveness with MP. Also a core algorithm base on LM was built to check the effect of MP by handling the parallel processing of 3 fitting function models, including fitting function parallelization, Jacobi method parallelization, Gaussian elimination parallelization. The experiment results show that MP can improve the performance of LM algorithms, and promote the capacity and responsiveness of the host system.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Mobile Client for The Numbering Resource Management System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The numbering resource management system, as an Internet-based e-government system, plays an important role in the administrative approval and service of numbering resources. With the continuous development of modern information technology, mobile government emerged as the times require, becoming a new public management and service mode. Against this background, China academy of information and communications technology have built a mobile client of the numbering resource management system. This paper studies the design principle of the mobile client of the numbering resource management system, analyses the functional requirements and system requirements of the software, introduces the design of each module of the client, and finally discusses its significance in the construction of mobile government services.

articleTitle: Forecast of Bicycle Sharing Demand Using BP Neural Network based on Improved Brain Storm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Public bicycle sharing systems can effectively improve the overall service level of urban public transport. The quality of bicycle sharing system depends on the accurate prediction of the public bicycle demand for each rental point. BP neural network (BPNN) could forecast public bicycle sharing demand. Based on the discussion that BPNN is sensitive to its initial weights and it is easy to fall into local minima, brain storm optimization algorithm is adopted to find optimum initial weights and thresholds It can be found that the algorithm has no fusion operation with the cluster center and the random individuals, which will easy to be premature. A novel improved BSO algorithm with 2 new regeneration modes is put forward in order to solve this problem,. The results show that the BPNN based on the improved brain storm optimization outperforms general BPNN in public bicycle sharing demand prediction.

articleTitle: Design and Demonstration of a SIMD System Based on the Bit-serial PE Array in FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This study described a new SIMD system architecture based on the bit-serial processor element (PE) array. In order to simplify the PE, the ALU merely has addition/subtraction and logical bit operations. And the unsigned /signed multiplication operations are decomposed into addition and shift operations, based on the booth multiplier principle. The SIMD system includes two decoding modules- the Control Part that filters the ALU instructions and processes the others and the Decoded Part that decodes the ALU instructions, especially the unsigned /signed multiplication instruction. An outline for three plans of multiplication is given and compared to optimize the design. Comprehensively considering the speed and resource utilization, the radix-4 plan was selected for the design and tested. We have experimentally demonstrated the bit processor array with multiplication operation using as few resources as possible.

articleTitle: Latent Markov Chain Encoding for Abnormal Landing Event Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Landing is a high-risk stage compared to other flight stages. The goal of this research is to detect abnormal landing events at early phase from live video surveillance alone. A weakly supervised feature coding method is proposed to enforce features shift in a predictable pattern. On top of this, a latent Markov chain model is proposed for abnormal events detection. Finally, a novel recurrent neural network (RNN) with relatively simple structure is proposed which integrates all proposed methods into one end-to-end model. Experiment results shows that this model is able to generate interpretable features from intermediate layers. The proposed model is capable to provided competitive abnormal event detection results.

articleTitle: Space Target Association Based on Epipolar Geometry Constraints under Multi-Star Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The star sensor can be used as a monitoring platform for space targets. The star target in the star map is a small target with no texture, color and other features. With the epipolar geometry constraint, the threshold value can be set first. The objects in the star maps taken by the star sensors overlapping the field of view are roughly associated. When multiple candidate targets are present, the associated target is the nearest one to the epipolar line. Finally, the relevant results are summarized and the observation information of each target under different platforms is obtained. The algorithm achieves the multi-objective synchronization association under multi-sensors and has good robustness to the jitter and deviation generated by the star sensor. When there are a large number of space targets in the star maps, the correlation accuracy can reach more than 90%.

articleTitle: Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Ultra High Speed Nano Wheel Gears in Aqueous Solutions
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Nano wheel gear is an integral part of the nano electromechanical system (NEMS). The nano wheel gear, with the advantages of ultra-high speed, wear resistance, long life and easy assembly, has been a hot research topic in many fields in recent years. In this paper, we proposed a new nano wheel gear of ultrahigh speed, easy assembly and low friction, based on the principle that carbon nanotube (CNT) suspended in aqueous solutions can rotate in the direction of water dipole under the induction of rotating electric fields. Nano wheel gears can be applied in all or part aqueous environments. Through molecular dynamics simulation, we found that, the lag angle between the nanomotor rotors and the water dipoles can be reduced by adjusting the rotating electric field speed or altering the electric field strength, and thus, the nanomotor rotors and the nano wheel gears can rotate in pace with the rotating electric field speed within the shortest time. The research is conductive to the precise control of the nano wheel gears. What's more, the simulation results also provide significant reference value to the application of the nono wheel gears as well as the design of complex mechanism such as nano automobiles and nano robots.

articleTitle: A Feedforward Control Strategy aiming at Withdrawal Disturbance of Load Side Resources
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In recent years, load side resources have been gradually applied to the frequency control of power systems. However, the characteristics of the load side resources are quite different from the generation side resources, especially the load side resources must secede the frequency control to ensure sufficient user tolerance. This characteristic causes withdrawal disturbance to the power systems, which does harm to the recovery of system frequency. In this paper, a feedforward control strategy is designed to reduce the negative impact of withdrawal disturbance of load side resources on the power systems, so as to improve the performance of the frequency recovery process. By informing the generator in advance about the withdrawal disturbance of load side resources, this method ensures that there are enough generation side resources to compensate when the load resources are withdrawn. The feedforward control strategy is simulated on the standard 10- machine 39-node system, and the experimental results show that the feedforward control can effectively reduce the impact of withdrawal disturbance by load side resources.

articleTitle: Study on ultrasonic-assisted drilling of Ti6Al4V using double cone drill in the finite element simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Continuous chip is one of the major problems during drilling Ti6A14V, and chip breaking is dependent on many factors such as drilling parameters, tool geometries and type of drill bits used. This paper attempts to analyze the effect of various drilling parameters such as feed rate, spindle speed on performance characteristics such as chip morphology, thrust force and temperature in conventional drilling (CD) and ultrasonic-assisted drilling (UAD) of Ti6A14V using twist and double cone drills in order to optimize the chip breakability of Ti6A14V. The results of the simulations not only reveal obvious varying regular pattern of thrust force, temperature with the increasing of feed rates, spindle speeds, which confirm the capability and advantage of FEM of the drilling process, but also provide a more profound knowledge about the drilling mechanism including the effect of double cone drills bit in UAD on chip breakability.

articleTitle: Automatic Character Recognition Method of Power Meter Based on Vision
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Intelligent recognition of power meter characters based on computer vision is one of the important research contents of power intelligence. For solving the problem of low recognition rate under poor imaging environment, this paper presents an modified stroke width transform and support vector machine. Our proposed algorithm is composed of two steps: detection and recognition. The experimental results show that the proposed method is effective accurately, and robust to various rotation, font sizes, font styles, and contrast levels. The contribution of this work is detecting and recognizing the power meter reading digits from electric meters in different situations.

articleTitle: Research on Time-sharing Control Strategy of shunt APF anti-Startup impulse
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In view of the problem of start-up impulse current and voltage when shunt active power filter is paralleled in the power grid, a time-sharing start-up strategy is proposed to suppress startup impulse current and voltage. The proposed method suppresses the impulse voltage by setting the magnitude of the command current at start-up, and then lets the command current equals the reverse harmonic current to compensate harmonic current when the DC-link voltage rises to the set value. Finally, the simulation results of pre-charge resistance, current limiting resistance and start-up strategy are given respectively. The results show that the method can the improve suppression of starting impact.

articleTitle: Multi-temporal Data Assimilation Method Based on Filtering Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: When the assimilation method of open space inversion data and observation data is studied, on the basis of the physical geometric models, aerospace remote sensing and ground observation, the multi-temporal data assimilation method based on filter optimization is often used to solve different The problem of accidental deviation under the sensor. This paper focuses on rice growth prediction, and uses the complementarity of surface model and Earth observation space to study the coupling of remote sensing and RiceGrow model after combining assimilation and renewal strategies, and finally validates the timeliness of the method through three case studies. It is proved that the results detected by the proposed method are closer to the actual results.

articleTitle: Application Researching of Container Technology on Satellite Control Center System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of spaceflight industry in recent years, the number of on-orbit satellites is rapidly increasing, the scale of the Satellite Control Center (SCC) is becoming larger and larger, and the cloud technology has been applied completely. Although the cloud technology plays an important role on improving system flexibility, reliability and recoverability of SCC, there are still some insufficiency to be solved at present, such as the virtual host configuration is yet complex, and the complexity and difficulty of system maintenance is rapidly increasing as more and more kinds of platform have been deployed. As a kind of lightweight virtualization technology, container technology encapsulates the business application, and runs on the operating system directly. The delivery and deploy time of SCC system can be reduced, the critical business application can be lightweight isolated, the system migration and extension ability can be improved according to characteristics of container technology. This paper presents an initial conception of the application of container technology on the current SCC system, and the qualitative and quantitative analysis of SCC system running critic technical indicators on the container is carried out, this gives a good way and a good reference model to the subsequent development and construction of the SCC system.

articleTitle: UHV Transmission Line Voltage early Warning Monitoring System based on big Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In view of the current problems caused by UHV voltage data monitoring, the voltage and data warnings are often artificially set to the upper and lower limit voltage values, so that in any case, the artificially set warning value is used. For the basis of judgment, it creates many security risks. The big data fusion and BP neural network are used to analyze the detected voltage data, and the temperature is introduced to further influence the influence of the voltage data, so that when judging the warning voltage value , more intelligent, which is more reliable than the result of manually setting the warning voltage value.

Author Keywords: voltage data monitoring and early warning

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection Method of Industrial Control System Based on RIPCA-OCSVM
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In view of the problem that the intrusion detection method based on One-Class Support Vector Machine (OCSVM) could not detect the outliers within the industrial data, which results in the decision function deviating from the training sample, an anomaly intrusion detection algorithm based on Robust Incremental Principal Component Analysis (RIPCA) -OCSVM is proposed in this paper. The method uses RIPCA algorithm to remove outliers in industrial data sets and realize dimensionality reduction. In combination with the advantages of OCSVM on the single classification problem, an anomaly detection model is established, and the Improved Particle Swarm Optimization (IPSO) is used for model parameter optimization. The simulation results show that the method can efficiently and accurately identify attacks or abnormal behaviors while meeting the real-time requirements of the industrial control system (ICS).

articleTitle: The Research of the SM2, SM3 and SM4 Algorithms in WLAN of Transformer Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the gradual extension of artificial intelligence applications in terminal equipment, intelligent terminals based on edge computing are also widely used in power systems. The new embedded terminal device with local decision function can process the collected raw data locally and only report the key information, which can reduces the requirement of network bandwidth, so makes the wireless transmission meet the needs of more business scenarios. In order to collect a large number of terminal data in time, traditional substations need high network bandwidth. The data can only be transmitted over wire. The data in new transformer substation with intelligent terminal can be aggregated by wireless transmission. But the data security of wireless networks such as IEEE802.11ah, LoRa , NBIoT and WiFi cannot be guaranteed. At the same time, with the needs of social development, data security has risen to the height of national security. In order to realize the "security and controllability" of information systems, China Cryptographic Administration has published a series of encryption and decryption algorithms such as SM2, SM3, SM4. In this paper, based on the IEEE802.11ah standard, we study the application of SM2, SM3 and SM4 in LAN of transformer substation, and mainly focus on the identity authentication, key distribution and data encryption and decryption. In view of the three different stages, the system scheme designs are proposed respectively, and then we analyze their security and the additional system overhead in detail. The research of the SM2, SM3 and SM4 algorithms in LAN of transformer substation will further promote the popularization and application of intelligent terminal in substaion, and this will also ehance the level of intelligence of substation.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Resource Allocation Algorithm Based on Auction Model in Mobile Blockchain Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Blockchain has been widely used in many fields such as bitcoin, smart contract, supply chain. However, because of the high requirement of computation and energy resource in mining process, blockchain application is restricted in mobile environment. In this paper, we introduce edge servers offered by Edge Service Provider into mobile blockchain network. Thus mining task can be offloaded from mobile devices to the edge server. Since there is competition among users, we propose an auction-based model for edge server resource allocation. Moreover, in order to maximize the revenue of all mobile users, we design a mechanism to achieve the allocation strategy and pricing rule for Edge Service Provider. Considering different resource demands, bids and usage time, we use Benders decomposition to get the dynamic resource allocation strategy. We evaluate the performance of the proposed auction model through extensive simulation. Results show that dynamic allocation can solve the resource allocation problem for Edge Service Provider and will get higher revenue with more winners than fixed allocation.

articleTitle: Study on Multipoint-Ranging-Target-Positioning Technologies for UAV
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: A target positioning method (mathematical model) and supporting photoelectric platform (physical model) based on laser ranging is proposed, which can be applied to ground and sea surface target geodetic coordinates information acquisition of UAV, especially low-cost UAV. The problem of photoelectric target consistency in the laser ranging process is solved by introducing image tracking. The impact of ranging Points' geometry configuration and laser ranging error on positioning accuracy of multipoint-ranging-target-positioning method is emphatically discussed. A practical geometric dilution of precision (GDOP) constructor is put forward. Kalman Filter is used to estimate the ranging points in real time, and the positioning process is converged recursively to improve the positioning accuracy. The study preliminary proved the practicability of the proposed model, and the effectiveness and feasibility of positioning method. As the aircraft trajectory can be planned and the target positioning process can be controlled in real time. The model and method proposed in this article can be applied to calculate the target position only by laser ranging and measuring point position, without complex north finding, attitude and photoelectric platform state measuring.

articleTitle: A Programmable Hamming Encoder/Decoder System Design with Quantum-dot Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Quantum-dot cellular automata (QCA) is a candidate paradigm for current CMOS logic circuits. Its inherent deep pipelining nature provides an expedience for bit-serial operations. However, many previous systems were implemented with bit- parallel circuits design because they can usually be achieved by direct equivalent conversion in lieu of conventional counterparts, which would cause problems of large area delay products and functional insufficiency. It is supposed to further exploit the aforementioned potentiality of QCA. In this work, we present a serial input serial output Hamming encoder/decoder communications system with QCA, which refers to both configurational and mathematical operations of bit string. The main contributions of this work are: first, a serial signal distribution network (SSDN) is proposed to achieve bit-serial data reshaping such as editing and alteration; second, we find the convolution computation may be a basic format for bit-serial operating circuits; third, the proposed system has a lower area delay product than previous work and employs an easily programmable structure.

articleTitle: The high-frequency weak signal detection based on Duffing Oscillators at Ultra Low SNR
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Identifying a Duffing oscillator state transition and determining the critical threshold of a Duffing oscillator system are indispensable in weak signal detection. However, the conventional algorithms for obtaining a critical threshold are complex and time-consuming, and they are greatly influenced by the noise intensity. Taken this into consideration, the phase point counting (PPC) method for the real-time detection of weak signals in noisy environments is proposed. In this method, by transforming the two-dimensional phase plane into the onedimensional time signal, the computational complexity can be simplified. i.e., we can obtain the critical threshold corresponding to different noise intensity with a faster speed. Simulation results show that the proposed method can improve the real-time performance and reduce the sufferance of chaotic critical points to noise to obtain a lower signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Furthermore, it can be extended to engineering applications more simply and efficiently.

articleTitle: A network updates scheme for software-defined airborne network of the aviation swarm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The emergence of software-defined networking (SDN) provides a new idea to break through the performance bottleneck of airborne network in the context of aviation swarm warfare. In order to overcome the problems of network updates in airborne network of aviation swarm, we propose a reliability enhanced two phase commit network updates strategy (RE-TPC), which is suitable for airborne network of aviation swarm under software-defined architecture. Firstly, the searching of high reliability paths are realized by designing the highest reliability algorithm and multi-paths algorithm. Then, ACK message-based confirmation mechanism is introduced to further improve the reliability, correctness and real-time performance of the network updates process. The simulation results show that, compared with the existing traditional network updates strategies, the updates strategy proposed in this paper not only effectively improves the reliability of network updates, but also reduces the duration.

articleTitle: Intelligent Beamforming Algorithm with Low Data Quality
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the field of radar digital signal processing, adaptive beamforming technology is a very valuable algorithm. For an actual system, the array may have outliers. These outliers affect the convergence of the adaptive beamforming algorithm, resulting in poor robustness of the algorithm under outliers. Therefore, this thesis applies a Huber-loss function and AdaGrad optimization algorithm in machine learning, and proposes a robust adaptive beamforming algorithm under strong interference. Through the simulation analysis, the Huber-loss loss function is insensitive to outliers, and the AdaGrad optimization algorithm can dynamically adjust the learning rate of each gradient component, making the optimization process converge faster, and the convergence is less sensitive to scale changes. Therefore, the paper applies the both to the adaptive beamforming algorithm, minimizing the influence of outliers on the adaptive algorithm and improving the adaptability of the algorithm to different data scales. And it can make the algorithm more robust.

articleTitle: A Survey on Network Measurement for Software-Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Network measurement is the basis of network research such as condition monitoring, performance management, and security defense. With the expansion of the network scale, the traditional network structure is complex, the management and control capabilities are weak, and the scalability is poor. As a new network architecture, software-defined network can better meet the needs of various network applications. Conducting measurement tasks in a software-defined network can help researchers grasp the operating state and resource consumption of the network, discover network bottlenecks and potential hazards, and improve network performance by optimizing the network structure. This paper studies the related technologies of broadband measurement, packet loss measurement and delay measurement in network performance measurement, and describes in detail the measurement methods, technical characteristics, advantages and disadvantages. The article concludes with a summary and suggests future work.

articleTitle: Structural Predictability Regulation for Graph data
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Graphs, also called "networks", have been proved to be an ideal paradigm for data representation in various domains, and structure prediction on graphs refers to estimating the potential relationship between objects from observed structures, being fundamental in many data analysis applications such as network alignment, network reconstruction and link prediction. Accordingly, to the users generating or utilizing the graph data, it is necessary to regulate the structural predictability of graphs against inference attack to protect the sensitive information about themselves or for error information reduction to mining more useful data about others respectively. In contrast to the existing works about graph structure perturbation for node ranking, information diffusion, etc., the structural predictability regulation problem, i.e., reducing or enhancing the accuracy of potential relationships prediction in graphs, hasn’t been extensively studied. This paper presents an active learning algorithm which selects the most representative links, and thus the structural predictability of graphs would be regulated via perturbing them. Specifically, with the assumption that graphs generally consist of regular and irregular components, in which the substructure with regular links has more equivalent paths supplied for the random walk processes, a random walk based link importance measuring algorithm is proposed to identify representative links. Extensive experiments on disparate real- world data sets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed graph structural predictability regulation method. In a word, the link importance estimation algorithm can capture the role of links accurately in terms of graph organization, and the structural predictability of graphs can be improved via irregular links based perturbation and be deteriorated by regular links based perturbation.

articleTitle: Research on Trajectory Anonymous Query using Network Voronoi Graph over Road Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The privacy protection method based on location service in the road network only focuses on the location privacy of users. When the query content proposed by the anonymous set mostly belongs to the same category, it is prone to homogeneity attack. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a privacy protection algorithm called V-L based on the (K, L) anonymous model. The algorithm first uses voronoi diagram to process the road network into independent voronoi diagram unit or known as V diagram unit, and then selects the anonymous set that satisfies (K, L) anonymous model in the current V diagram unit for the user, and finally adds false user to the anonymous set that does not satisfy (K,L) anonymous model, and randomly selects the location of the current V diagram unit to replace the real location of the user. The algorithm is verified by the data of Lanzhou road network. Experimental results show that on the basis of query cost slightly higher than traditional algorithms, the anonymous success rate of the proposed algorithm can be guaranteed to be 100%, and the average anonymous time is about 1ms. It is proved that the algorithm we proposed achieves a good balance between privacy protection intensity and algorithm performance.

articleTitle: The mean-variance-skewness cardinality constrained portfolio optimization problem using a customized multi-objective evolutionary algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: MVSCCPO is a mean-variance-skewness portfolio optimization problem with cardinality constraint. It increases the skewness as the third objective, and introduces cardinality constraint to reduce the difficulty of asset management. A customized NSGA-III(c-NSGA-III) algorithm is proposed for the problem. It introduces an effective solution representation mechanism, customized crossover and mutation operators, a tournament selection based on membership is introduced in the mating selection phase instead of the original random selection method. Finally, an empirical analysis is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm by comparing with NSGA-II and MOEA/D. The results show that c-NSGA-III performs better than other algorithms on solving MVSCCPO problem.

articleTitle: A Novel IMA Resource Configuration Method based on Feature Modeling and Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Integrated Modular Avionics (IMA) is the latest generation of avionics systems, with a high level of integration and modularity that make more integrated functions and more sharing of resources. Software product line engineering (SPLE) approaches can reduce the cost associated with developing complex systems like IMA and obtain More IMA configurations which meet user requirements. Feature selection of the feature model resulting from the domain modeling is a key step in obtaining the functionality needed and the characteristics of the user. Due to the high safety requirements of the IMA system, various resident applications need to be provisioned at development time to meet various safety constraints, which makes the feature selection process need to consider the IMA resource configuration constraints. In this paper, by extending the feature model, the feature model can express the information of the software mapping in the IMA resource configuration. We also used the multi-objective genetic algorithm to optimize the functional and non-functional requirements. Moreover, experiments are carried out on different scale models to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Similarity Analysis Methods of Medium and Small Watersheds Based on Mutual Information
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to get the similarity degree between watersheds according to geographic morphological information, we propose a method to select similar medium and small watersheds based on mutual information. Firstly, the range of watersheds and eighteen watershed characteristics are extracted based on the DEM data. Then, K-means is used to discretize the watershed characteristics, and the mutual information-based method is applied to make the unsupervised feature selection. Finally, different subsets of characteristics are constructed by affinity propagation clustering algorithm to get different cluster members. Through the consistency integration of the co-association matrix, the voting information of the similarity degree of watersheds can be obtained. Experiments indicate that similar watersheds identified by this method have high similarity in flood process.

articleTitle: Multi-format speech perception hashing based on time-frequency parameter fusion of energy zero ratio and frequency band variance
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the existing speech content authentication algorithm, such as single format, ununiversal algorithm, low security, low accuracy of tamper detection and location in small-scale, a multi-format speech perception hashing based on time-frequency parameter fusion of energy zero ratio and frequency band bariance is proposed. Firstly, the algorithm preprocesses the processed speech signal and calculates the short-time logarithmic energy, zero-crossing rate and frequency band variance of each speech fragment. Then calculate the energy to zero ratio of each frame, perform time- frequency parameter fusion on time-frequency features by mean filtering, and the time-frequency parameters are constructed by difference hashing method. Finally, the hash sequence is scrambled with equal length by logistic chaotic map, so as to improve the security of the hash sequence in the transmission process. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm is robustness, discrimination and key dependent.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement Using Illuminator Cognition Technique for Passive Bistatic Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: We propose a processing scheme for passive bistatic radar(PBR) in co-channel interference scenarios with multi-transmit single-receive topology based on frequency modulated broadcasting transmitters. We separate the direct signal of each co-frequency transmitter utilizing blind source separation (BSS) and perform clutter suppression in the surveillance channel exploiting signal-fast-time adaptive processing (SFTAP) in BSS domain. To solve the permutation problem of BSS, an adaptive canceler based on recursive least square criterion (RLS) is used to the output of the BSS and the digital beam forming beam. The target detection problem in presence of co-frequency interferences and strong ground clutter is transformed into a conventional passive bistatic radar with multiple illuminators via the above processing. Based on waveform selection in terms of the illuminator bandwidth, we propose an approach to select a better illuminator to accomplish target detection. The validity of the proposed approach is tested by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: The Research of the Persona of Online Car-hailing Drivers based on Density Peak Clustering
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to study the types and characteristics of drivers in online car-hailing industry, we establish the model which combine user persona theory and density peak clustering algorithm. User persona is widely used in customer analysis of various industries because it can vividly and richly display user characteristics. This paper introduces the user persona theory when studying the customer clustering method, constructs the user persona model based on multi-level user data, and designs the process of user persona construction. In the empirical part, density peak clustering algorithm is used for data experiment. The results show the clustering result obtained by the model of user persona theory and density peak algorithm is well. According to the clustering centers, we analyze the characteristics of different types of customers and provide strategies and opinions for enterprise marketing, which is an effective research method of user persona.

articleTitle: A Reference Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Industrial Internet Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the continuous innovation of new-generation information technology and its accelerated integration with manufacturing industry, industrial internet platforms (IIPs) are rapidly emerging worldwide. IIP construction and promotion has become a new competition focus of global leading enterprises, and a new direction of industrial development in various countries. However, the development of IIP is still in exploration, and the industry still lacks unified understanding of the composition, functions and their interrelationships of IIP. As a result, the IIPs construction presents a disorderly development trend, and is faced with problems and challenges of unclearness of development path, indeterminacy of technical system, and unsoundness of business model. So, this paper firstly constructs a reference architecture of IIP to clarify its hierarchical framework and core functions, so as to provide a general reference model for the industry to understand and jointly promote IIP construction. Secondly, an evaluation system is proposed to guide the healthy development of IIP. The evaluation framework is composed from three dimensions namely the foundation guarantee, key capability, value and benefit, and the specific evaluation index system is also given. Finally, the application process and method of IIP evaluation are described with a practical case.

articleTitle: A Case Study of Formal Model based System Safety Analysis in Aviation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of safety-critical systems, it's a great challenge to improve the safety during the stage of system designs. Model based complex system design and formal analysis are an important system safety modelling and analysis methodology. In this paper, a case study is given to show how to apply this method into aerospace industry, that is, a Wheel Brake System (WBS) (which is a typical safeiy-critical sample system adopted in an aviation standard SAE-AIR6110) is used for demonstration of modelling and formal analysis. In AIR6110 standard, the requirement semantics described by natural language are ambiguous. Therefore, it is necessary to eliminate the ambiguity and establish a formal model of WBS system firstly, including: the structure of WBS is analyzed hierarchically at the system model design level, and the functions of WBS system described by natural language are strictly modeled in a formal language (SLIM, a subset of AADL). The possible faults of the system elements are considered and various types of fault modes are designed. Also the semantics of faulty behavior of the formal functional model is extended based on these fault modes. Then the safety of the extended system model is analyzed, such as FTA analysis. The case analysis demonstrates the validity and practicability of the model-based safety analysis method in Industrial systems.

articleTitle: Expression Recognition Based on Multi-feature Fusion of Peak-neutral Differences
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) is an important research direction of pattern recognition. This paper proposes a multi-feature fusion network based on peak-neutral difference (MFPND). The network consists of two branches: One branch extracts the local features of the expression changes from the partial image, and the other branch extracts the global features of the expression changes from the entire image. In this model, Local features describe the details of expression changes, which are fused by geometric spatial features and Local Binary Pattern (LBP) features. The global features describe high-level semantic information, which is extracted by the Siamese network composed of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). Before classifying, we combined local features with global features. Compared with most current methods of single feature type, these two features represent expression information of different scales, and this model can more comprehensively and effectively represent expression changes. In addition, in the training phase, a new pooling strategy is proposed to deal with disturbances such as illumination and noise during expression changes, which is called intensity transformation-invariant pooling (ITI-pooling). Experiments were performed on the extended Cohn±Kanade (CK+) face recognition database and the Oulu-CASIA data set.

articleTitle: Trajectory Anonymity Based on Quadratic Anonymity
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Due to the leakage of privacy information in the sensitive region of trajectory anonymity publishing, which is resulted by the attack, this paper aims at the trajectory anonymity algorithm of division of region. According to the start stop time of the trajectory, the current sensitive region is found with the k-anonymity set on the synchronous trajectory. If the distance between the divided sub-region and the adjacent anonymous area is not greater than the threshold d, the area will be combined. Otherwise, with the guidance of location mapping, the forged location is added to the sub-region according to the original location so that the divided sub-region can meet the principle of k-anonymity. While the forged location retains the relative position of each point in the sensitive region, making that the divided sub-region and the original Regional anonymity are consistent. Experiments show that compared with the existing trajectory anonymous algorithm and the synchronous trajectory data set with the same privacy, the algorithm is highly effective in both privacy protection and validity of data quality.

articleTitle: Target Detection in Spectral Images Based on Non-reconstructed Compressed Sampling
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The theoretical framework of compressed signal processing is introduced into the problem of target detection in spectral image. The method of target detection in spectral image based on non-reconstructed compressed sampling is explored. The influence of target abundance on detection performance in linear spectral mixture model is analyzed. The compressed sampling matrix is improved by the prior knowledge of the sparse model of the target spectral signal to be measured, and a sparse model first is proposed. Compressed sampling detection method under test conditions and its detection performance are analyzed in detail. The simulation results show that using sparse model prior knowledge to improve the compressed sampling matrix can not only significantly improves the performance of the compressed sampling detection, but also effectively enhances the robustness of the compressed sampling detection algorithm.

articleTitle: A Model Based Safety Analysis Framework for SysML and A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Model Based Safety Analysis (MBSA) techniques can improve our modeling and analysis capabilities for today's complex safety-critical system designs. SysML is a kind of informal system functional modeling language widely used in industry and AltaRica is a formal modeling language for system safety analysis. This paper provides a MBSA framework and a prototype tool for SysML oriented system design and safety ananlysis, which including: we firstly extend SysML model elements to describe system fault events and behaviors by using profile definition mechanism, then some mapping rules between SysML design models and AltaRica analysis models are established based on the consideration of model semantics. Therefore, we can design a framework and algorithms to implement an automatic conversion of those two modeling languages Finally, a case study shows how to modeling and analyze a typical wheel brake system which included in the SAE-AIR6110 standard by using a prototype tool.

articleTitle: Under voltage lockout circuit design for enhanced GaN HEMT drive
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: An under-voltage locking circuit for driving chip is designed to ensure the stability of the enhanced GaN HEMT driving voltage. Firstly, SPICE model of enhanced GaN HEMT device is used to build the circuit. The basic electrical characteristics of the device are analyzed. Then the parasitic inductance of the enhanced GaN HEMT device caused by PCB wiring and pad layout is simulated. According to the volt-ampere characteristics of parasitic PNP transistors in Shanghua CSMC 0.5um CMOS process, an under-voltage locking circuit with Schmidt flip-flops and inverters at the output end is designed which improves the driving ability of the circuit. When the power supply voltage rises/falls between 3-5V, the rising/falling threshold is 4.1V/3.7V, and the threshold hysteresis is 400mV. When the temperature changes from - 40°C to 125°C, there is a small temperature drift. This under voltage lock out circuit can effectively prevent the power supply from abnormal transition due to noise and load-induced interference and the incomplete conduction state of the enhanced GaN HEMT.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Metal Welding Technology of Cascaded Battery Connection
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Nowadays, cascaded battery is the power source of new-energy vehicles. The paper studies the effects of technological parameters, such as input energy, welding duration, position of tabs, welding material and number of welding layers on the morphology of combined interface and microstructure. A relatively better welding effect will be obtained when the input energy of the welding machine is 108J, the welding duration is 1.2s, and the pressure of the welding chuck is 0.2Mpa.

articleTitle: Research on SSD Algorithm Based on Occlusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Pedestrian detection as a basic identification technology, providing technical support for many areas such as security monitoring and automatic driving, and has a wide range of application scenarios. This article is based on the Single Shot Detector(SSD)target detection algorithm, a pedestrian detection system based on the SSD target detection framework was trained using a self-built occlusion pedestrian data set for the specific goal of occluding pedestrians, then the features learned by deep convolution neural network are more robust. For the occlusion pedestrian detection, the network structure of the SSD model has been modified accordingly. The depth can be divided into convolutions to simplify the feature extraction network, reduce the number of network parameters, reduce the training difficulty, and improve the algorithm operation speed. Further, in the prenetwork of the SSD model, the SE-Inception structure was added, and the a priori frame in the network was redesigned to make it easier to match the shape of the pedestrian. In the case of pedestrians who are prone to environmental occlusion and mutual occlusion, data on occlusion pedestrians is added to the training set of the model. The Repulsion Loss enhanced model is used to block the detection of pedestrians, and the experimental results show that the detection performance of the improved SSD model has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: A Path Planning Algorithm for Sweeping Robot Based on Improved Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper plans to solve the problem of the lacks of traditional path planning algorithm in self-learning and the disadvantages in local path planning. We propose a path-planning algorithm for sweeping robots based on improved neural network. It is aimed to provide a collision-free planning route for robots in an unknown environment. This algorithm is based on the neural network algorithm, which concludes a four-layer structure of network, and designs the energy function as the evaluation function of the network. First I need to find the extreme value of the energy function, and then I need to adjust the motion based on the path points, next, the robot completes the path planning task. The effectiveness of the method is proved by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A Design of Construction Management Site Control Platform Based on Mobile Application Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Electricity is an important pillar of the entire national economy. In order to effectively ensure the safe operation of substation, transmission and distribution equipment and lines, strengthen personal safety risk control of power construction site operations, safety risk control of power grid systems, and actively promote grid construction site operations. All-round, three-dimensional security control is essential. Mobile application technology has wide-area coverage, easy access, non-line-of-sight transmission, large capacity and high reliability. The construction operation site management and control platform based on mobile application technology realizes the development of industrial technology, and improves work quality and changes traditional operation methods.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of The Corrugated Flexure Beams Clamping Paired Double Parallel Parallelogram Flexure Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of under-constraints of the secondary motion stage in paired double parallelogram mechanism, a paired double parallelogram mechanism based on the clamping of corrugated flexure beams is designed in this paper, called double parallelogram mechanism with corrugated flexure beam (CFB-DP-DP). The mechanism uses a corrugated flexure beam to constrain the motion of the two secondary stages of the double parallelogram mechanism, thereby effectively improving its dynamic characteristics. Firstly, the physical model and dynamic model of the traditional paired double parallelogram (DP-DP) flexure, the clamped paired double parallelogram (C-DP-DP) flexure and the corrugated beam clamping paired double parallelogram mechanisms (CFB-DP-DP) are established. Secondly, the modal analysis of the three mechanisms is carried out by finite element simulation, and the analytical and simulation solutions of the first modal natural frequency are compared. The error between the two solutions is less than 10%. Finally, the dynamic simulation results of the three flexible mechanisms are compared. The results show that the natural frequencies of the modes of the corrugated beam-clamping parallel four-bar mechanism are higher than those of the other two parallel four-bar mechanisms. The natural frequency of the state is significantly improved, and the natural frequency of the third mode is increased by up to 20%. In summary, the double parallelogram flexible mechanism clamped with corrugated beams can constrain the motion of two secondary stage and improves the high-order natural frequency of the stage, and play an important role in improving the motion stability of the mechanism and reducing redundant vibration.

articleTitle: UIO-based Cyber Attack Detection and Mitagation Scheme for Load Frequency Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Cyber attack affects the frequency regulation of load frequency control (LFC) system, which could cause instability in power systems. In this paper, false data injection (FDI) attacks for tie- line power measurements are specifically studied, and a novel attack detection and mitigation scheme is proposed to reduce the harm caused by it. First, we design an unknown input observer (UIO) to estimate the true value of tie-line power. Then, a signal credibility function is designed to detect attacks. The signal credibility function is based on the numerical difference and the slope difference between the estimated signal and the measured signal. We detect the attack by comparing the evaluation function of the signal with the evaluating indicator. Finally, the purpose of attack mitigation is achieved by replacing the measured value with the estimated value of the tie line power. From the simulation results of a multi-area LFC control system, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Moving Object Tracking Algorithm Based on Improved Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The moving object image frame has characteristics such as fast change of frame, large moving range, large difference between frames and rapid change of background image, which lead to tracking foreground misjudgment, tracking lag and even losing track objectives. In order to solve this problem, we propose a moving object tracking algorithm based on Gaussian mixture model. By setting up the mixed Gaussian model and updating the dynamic pixel parameters, we eliminate the effect of pixel reduction caused by rapid change of image frame, remove background image interference, and solves the problem of tracking lag. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the accuracy and lag of moving objects tracking in complex background and achieve good tracking performance compared with traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on the Directivity and Signal Processing of Hybrid Acoustic Vector Sensor Array
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: A hybrid acoustic vector sensor array (HAVSA) is consisted mainly of pressure hydrophones and a few vector sensors within. It can acquire good direction-finding results as well as the ability to discriminate the left-right ambiguity at a considerably low cost, and thus is regarded as a promising novel array configuration. In this paper we have deduced the formula of the directivity of HAVSA, and analyzed its characteristics. Results showed that factors, such as the number and positions of vector sensors utilized in HAVSA, the steering angle, and the signal frequency will change the main lobe width, the height of the side lobes, and the left-right ambiguity elimination performance of the array. Furthermore, the general processing method of the HAVSA for DOA estimation is presented, and conventional beamforming (CBF) and Capon beamforming methods are applied. Results show that the HAVSA has the ability to suppress the left-right ambiguity, and the Capon beamforming outperforms CBF. The present work can provide a good reference for the configuration designing and the algorithm researching of HAVSA.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Emergency QoS of Publish-Subscribe Middleware Based on DDS
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the scene of publish / subscribe applications, users usually have QoS (Quality of Service) requirements. In some scenarios, the urgent data need to be delivered preferentially. However, relevant QoS which meets such requirements doesn't exist in DDS specification and commercial publish/subscribe middleware currently. To sovle this problen, the paper put forward an Emergency QoS measure, to modify the scheduler in publish/subscribe, which scheduling data publishing subscription depends on Emergency QoS value, so as to achieve immediate dispose to emergency tasks. Test results reveal that the introduction of Emergency QoS achieves the desired goals.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling on the M2M Data Traffic in IOT
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: According to the research method for flow in network, this paper analyses the characteristics of M2M data traffic, especially for the collected data upload in monitor system. The feature of network traffic are studied at multiple time. The stochastic characteristics of data flow are discussed, as well as statistical analysis and modeling are carried out. The improved frame structure of MAC layer ,which includes the spatial scale information of nodes, is proposed.

articleTitle: The method of fault line selection for distribution network based on adaptive scale symlets wavelet
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing line selection method judges the error of the fault line in the single-phase grounding fault of the small current system, the paper proposes the non-stationary signal based on the single-phase grounding fault generated by the neutral point arc-suppression coil grounded system, a power distribution fault line selection method based on adaptive scale Symlets wavelet is designed. The voltage increment and current increment after the grounding fault are determined by wavelet transform to determine the fault time and the appropriate line selection scale, then the maximum value of each line mode and its polarity is obtained. Experiments show that the adaptive scale Symlets wavelet fault line selection method can quickly and accurately select fault lines with higher reliability and accuracy.

articleTitle: A P2P trust model based on trust factor and feedback aggregation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: As one of the important solutions to P2P network security problems, P2P trust model has attracted much attention. However, the dynamic, self-organization and decentralization of P2P network also trigger new challenges to the construction and management of trust model. A P2P trust model based on hybrid network structure is proposed by studying the existing model. This model has completed synthetic evaluation of trust by combining direct with and indirect trust. The trust factor is set in direct calculation to give full consideration to the service trade such as service time, frequency, and the success rate. The feedback trust tree is proposed to complete trust aggregation in indirect trust calculation to improve the efficiency and accuracy. At the same time, the model also strengthens the function of restraining malicious behavior. Simulation results have shown that the convergence speed and credibility of trust calculation are improved obviously compared with some classical methods.

articleTitle: Noise Suppression for Surface Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Data Based on Frame Energy Spectrum Subtraction
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: As an advanced groundwater detection instrument, surface nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR)instrument is having more attention on the field of international water exploration technology. However, the surface NMR instrument is very susceptible to electromagnetic interference (EMI) during measurement, and noise suppression is one of the key research issues in surface NMR field. We propose a novel noise suppression method for noisy surface NMR data based on frame energy spectral subtraction. In the method, it is to first allow surface NMR receiver to only collect noise data in the ambient environment, and then to sequentially perform surface NMR transmitter and receiver to record the noisy surface NMR data. Then we use frame energy spectrum subtraction method to deal with noisy surface NMR data and achieve noise suppression. Simulation experiment and field experiment demonstrate that the method can effectively suppress random noise and harmonic noise and improve signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). The method lays a foundation for the detection application of surface NMR instruments in strong EMI ambient environment, and provides a guarantee for the surface NMR inversion.

articleTitle: The Study on the 3300V Low Loss FS-IGBT
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: A 3300V/62.5A low loss FS-IGBT was developed by using the carrier storage layer structure and laser annealing process on the back p+ collector, which could lower the saturation voltage. The effects of laser annealing energy and P+ collector dose on dynamic and static state were studied. Considering the trade-off of the turn-off loss and the saturation voltage, the IGBT was finally designed with the 2.35V saturation voltage, 132mJ turn-off loss.

articleTitle: Tire pattern similarity detection based on template matching and LBP
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Before testing the similarity of the tire pattern, the following problems must be solved: the background image of the tire is complicated, the angle of the pattern is varied, and the illumination is inconsistent. In this paper, the traditional template matching method is optimized by Hue, Saturation, Value color model (HSV) and Sobel operator, so that the acquired target image has higher accuracy. The original Local Binary Pattern(LBP) algorithm is improved to make it more suitable for tire pattern similarity detection while overcoming the problem of variable pattern angle.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Based on Weighted Fusion of Face Similarity Features
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: A method for weighted fusion of similarity features to describe faces is proposed. Similarity feature is extracted from similar face, which has good stability. The fusion of uncorrelated similarity features is more conducive to face recognition. Firstly, the Euclidean distance between similarity features is calculated, and the similarity features are screened to find a set of uncorrelated similarity features, which effectively reduces the number of features and removes redundant information between similarity features. Then, the similarity features are adaptive weighted fusion and the fusion result is detected in the AR face database. The final simulation experiment achieve good results.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Information Leakage Classification Detection Method for Computer Display Equipment Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The detection of electromagnetic information leakage is aimed at confirming security vulnerabilities that existing in electronic devices. Computer display is a kind of important electronic device. The traditional method of detecting electromagnetic information leakage from computer displays is to reconstruct original image. It is necessary for reconstruction technology to understand the working mechanism of the detected equipment and other relevant information. However, this process tends to be complex so that it is hard to realize the detection. This paper proposes a classification detection method based on Machine Learning. It can detect electromagnetic information leakage by classifying and identifying the electromagnetic information radiated from computer display equipment. In experiment, we preprocess electromagnetic signal through Wavelet Transform, design a three-layer convolutional neural network, classify the samples correctly. The detection method based on Machine Learning overcomes the technical drawback that traditional detection methods need to reconstruct. We compare with other common Machine Learning algorithms. The experiment result shows that the method based on three-layer convolutional neural network and wavelet transform has good accuracy in the classification and detection of electromagnetic leakage of computer monitors.

articleTitle: Design of automotive brakejoint size detection system based on TIA Portal
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low detection accuracy and low efficiency of the size detection of automobile brake joints, a set of detection system based on TIA Portal is designed. The system uses Siemens S7-1200 PLC (Program Logistic Controller) as the controller, servo motor as the system running motor, and Siemens TP900 Smart Series HMI control panel as the control panel. The system can set the total number of detections through the HMI touch screen, and monitor the signal through the sensor to monitor the system running process in real time to ensure the normal operation of the system. The configuration simulation results show that the system not only has the characteristics of safety and high efficiency, but also greatly improves the detection efficiency of the brake joint size of the automobile, reduces the production cost of the enterprise, and further improves the automation degree of the brake joint size detection.

articleTitle: Corner smoothing interpolation algorithm based on PH curve
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the process of machining, sharp corners will exist at the joints of continuous short line segments, and most spline curves cannot establish the accurate relationship between arc length and parameters. For the corner transition path of the short segment, the five-degree PH˄Pythagorean-Hodograph˅ curve is adopted to realize high-speed smooth transition by adjusting the control points of the curve and restricting the length of the transition segment. The corner error is small by experimentally comparing the NURBS algorithm. Effectively reduce the tool vibration.

articleTitle: AGV Path Planning Based on Optimized Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of AGV path planning and obstacle avoidance in intelligent warehouse, this paper proposes an optimized particle swarm optimization (POS) algorithm. Through the immune information adjustment and optimization mechanism in the immune algorithm, the particle diversity in the particle group is improved and the understanding ability is improved. The overall nature. The grid map is simulated by MATLAB. The results show that the optimized particle swarm optimization algorithm has better adaptability, and the optimal path search capability has a certain improvement, which makes the AGV running path shorter, thus improving the efficiency of the intelligent warehouse.

articleTitle: Circulation suppression control method based on dynamic droop coefficient adjustment
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper investigates problem of circulating current between the output terminals of parallel converters in DC microgrid system. The dynamic regulation droop control proposes a drooping coefficient with real-time variation to minimize the circulating current. By monitoring the voltage deviation of the converter output port, the dynamic droop coefficient is accurately corrected so that the circulating current in the parallel converter system can be stably and well controlled. Matlab simulation results analysis, compared with the traditional control method, the circulating current problem has been improved.

articleTitle: Research on The Secure Transmission Method of Terminal Upgrade Files based on Dynamic Encryption Key
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to improve the secure transmission capability of terminal upgrade files, we proposed a secure transmission method of terminal upgrade files based on dynamic encryption key. This method realized the access control of terminal upgrade file by using no proxy key publishing protocol, designed the dynamically symmetric key for the terminal upgrade file. The encoding calculation of terminal upgrade files in the process of secure encryption is carried out based on bilinear mapping method.
