We scrambled and rearranged the terminal upgrade files according to the intensity of plaintext attack, then adopted the random linear coding method to encrypt the terminal upgrade files by dynamic symmetric key and realize the secure transmission for the files. Simulation results show that this method can effectively improve the security transfer performance of upgrade files, and can meet the requirements of current business applications.

articleTitle: Backstepping Sliding Approach for Controlling a Quadrotor Using Barrier Lyapunov Functions
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The dynamics of a quadrotor has the characteristics of underactuation, strong coupling, and nonlinearities, which makes the controller design difficult. Aimed at stabilizing the attitude of a quadrotor, In this paper, we establish the dynamics of the quadrotor. Based on the simplified dynamics model, we design a backstepping sliding based controller using Barrier Lyapunov Functions. Numerical examples and comparisons with traditional backstepping approach are provided to show the effectiveness and the superiority of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Fast separation algorithm of mixed signals based on GEVD
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of mixed signal separation, we propose a fast algorithm based on generalized eigenvalue decomposition. On the basis of removing redundant signals, the observation matrix bundle is established by FIR filtering method, and then the source signal is separated by solving its eigenvector and eigenvalue matrix. Theoretical analysis and simulation experiments show that the proposed algorithm can effectively separate source signals, and the separation efficiency is greatly improved compared with existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Improved genetic algorithm and its application in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Genetic algorithm is a kind of optimization method based on the theoretical research of natural evolution system. It has some very good advantages. However, the local search ability of the genetic algorithm is not strong, even if it can quickly reach the vicinity of the optimal solution, which relies on strong local convergence .but it takes a long time to search for the optimal solution. In order to avoid this phenomenon, an effective method is to adopt a hybrid strategy. That is to say, a fast convergence local optimization algorithm is introduced in the process of genetic evolution to form a hybrid genetic algorithm. This paper will study the combination of genetic algorithm and complex method, which is called improved genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Recommendation algorithm based on users’ interest preferences and Restricted Boltzmann machine
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to overcome the disadvantages of recommendation algorithm based on restricted Boltzmann machine, which only uses the severely sparse scoring matrix in the training process, and can not effectively extract user characteristics effectively, and also ignores the users' interests and item attributes. a recommendation algorithm based on users' interest preferences and Restricted Boltzmann Machines is proposed. Firstly, the Restricted Boltzmann machines for collaborative filtering algorithm is utilized to predict the user rating of the item is r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>; then the information of users' interest preference is used to establish a users' rating preference model, and predict the user rating the item is r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>; Finally, the linear regression algorithm is utilized to confirm the weights of r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> to obtain the final prediction score r . The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm in this paper can improve the predicted accuracy of the recommendation system.

articleTitle: Design of remote data acquisition system for hydraulic impactor based on virtual instrument
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The paper designs a remote data acquisition system for hydraulic impactor by using virtual instrument technology, which simplifies the cumbersome acquisition process of traditional instruments. Writing the server and client program based on LabVIEW software and DataSocket communication technology. Then carrying out an experiment and analyzing the signal acquired from the client to verify the reliability of the data acquisition system.

articleTitle: Automatic Building Extraction Based on High Resolution Aerial Images
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Building extraction is a hotspot of research. Buildings in remote sensing images are numerous, and buildings have different distribution patterns in different regions, which means it is difficult to extract buildings by one traditional method for all areas. Deep learning plays more and more important part of computer version and image processing, which has made some progress in target detection and identification, especially in medical graphic recognition. In this paper, we compared three common datasets, and selected the most suitable one. Mask R- CNN is applied to this dataset. We provided a better method and this method can be used in different areas when dataset is rich enough for training. The method in this paper just need high resolution aerial images to extract buildings automatically without any other steps, because identification and extraction are achieved in one network. The research showed: the dataset we selected is suitable; Mask R-CNN can be used in high resolution remotely images; Mask R-CNN is good at building extraction, and greatly reduce the loss of classification and leakage. Therefore, this paper provided a suitable method for automatic building extraction.

articleTitle: Complexity and Accuracy Analysis of Convolutional Neural Networks in Scene Text Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Machine vision, deep learning and convolutional neural networks have been applied to scene text detection by more and more scholars, whom proposed many excellent methods like Faster R-CNN, Connectionist Text Proposal Network (CTPN) and Arbitrary-Oriented Scene Text Detection via Rotation Proposals (RRPN). This article analyzes the various indicators and detection accuracy of these three methods. On the network architecture, Faster R-CNN is more complex than RRPN and CTPN. In terms of detection accuracy, the F-measure of RRPN is 0.18 higher than Faster R-CNN; the F-measure of CTPN is 0.15 higher than Faster R-CNN. However, these three methods have different emphasis on the detected text in the process of scene text detection. CTPN has better performance for laterally distributed scene text detection; RRPN is superior for scene text detection with tilt angle.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Convolutional Neural Network-based Soil Moisture Feature Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Soil moisture is one of the important physical characteristics of soil, and it is the basis for judging whether the soil needs irrigation. Based on the theory of deep learning and the technology of convolution neural network, this study realizes image-based soil moisture recognition, thus realizing the automation of soil irrigation. The convolution core, convolution layer, pool layer and the corresponding parameter feedback mechanism are constructed according to the characteristics of soil images with different humidity, based on which, the convolution neural network for soil moisture identification is constructed. Trained by 1200 soil image samples with corresponding humidity, a stable deep learning network has been established. Experiments show that the accuracy rate of soil moisture identification of the deep learning network reaches 85%, reaching the practical level.

articleTitle: Image segmentation based on bat algorithm and pulse coupled neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Image segmentation plays an important role in image processing and computer vision. The pulse coupled neural network has been applied in image segmentation. The pulse coupled neural network model has many parameters which have the influence on the performance. And the parameters optimization becomes a problem. Bat algorithm is inspired by the echolocation behavior of natural bats in determining their foods and also applied in many optimization problem. In this paper, the bat algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of pulse coupled neural network and the pulse coupled neural network is applied in image segmentation. The results show that the new algorithm has better performance than the threshold algorithm and otsu image segmentation algorithm.

articleTitle: An Infrared Image Enhancement Method Based on Power Function Histogram Equalization
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Traditional histogram equalization and gray transformation enhancement algorithms cannot effectively enhance infrared images. After comparing the advantages and disadvantages of various algorithms, this paper proposes a histogram equalization algorithm based on power function. The algorithm realizes the redistribution of the gray level of the original image by processing the histogram of the original image with square and threshold translation, reduces the over-merging and over-stretching of the gray level, and can effectively resist the disturbance of the image caused by the sudden entry of bright and dark scenes. The enhancement effect of the infrared image is obvious.

articleTitle: Web crawler design, implementation and data analysis about Sina Weibo
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, discussed designed and implemented a crawler base on python language and use this program crawl posts from Sina weibo. The key word is academic library. The time span is from 1/1/2018 to 31/12/2018 and the total number is 39374 and make data clean, cut words and delete all text that no related to academic library. After that, analyzed this data set for knowing the user’s attitude about library. In order to describe the situation better, high frequency words rank, cloud word, semantic network about image of Library service, semantic network been used. Finally, according to the user's attitude, make the the necessary discuss.

articleTitle: A Fusion Network Power Control Method for High Speed Carrier Communication and Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Electricity information acquisition requires low power consumption for communication system. In this paper, a power control method for high-speed carrier communication and wireless communication fusion is proposed. Based on the dual- mode fusion model, the transmission path is reasonably selected, the transmission power is dynamically adjusted to reduce power consumption in the communication process, and the success rate of communication is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Quantum Chicken Swarm Optimization with Levy Flight and Its Application in Parameter optimization of Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of unbalanced global and local search ability and optimization accuracy in chicken swarm optimization, we propose a quantum chicken swarm optimization with Levy flight (L-QCSO). First, the quantum system is used to increase the search space of the roosters. Second, the Levy flights strategy is used to improve the hens behavior. Finally, the improved chicken swarm optimization is used to optimize the number of tree and the number of split variables pre-selected by the tree node on the random forest. In the experiment, results show that the optimized chicken swarm optimization is effective and better than the chicken swarm optimization on the benchmark functions. In the end, the optimized chicken swarm optimization is used to optimize RF, which is applied into oil layer recognition. Results show that this optimization model is superior to the RF in terms of recognition rate and time.

articleTitle: Study on the Technology of High-Dynamic-Range Low-Light-Level Remote-Sensing Camera
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In recent years, Low-Light-Level (LLL) remote - sensing camera has become a novel subject for the development of aerospace optical remote-sensing payloads. In this article, the status quo and trend of LLL remote-sensing imaging technology is introduced. The technical method for LLL remote-sensing imaging is studied. In view of the requirement of high-dynamic-range (HDR) LLL imaging in space remote sensing, a camera based on an Intensified Charge-Coupled Device (ICCD) is designed. A method to measure the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the LLL camera is proposed and tested. A field experiment for the LLL camera is also carried out. The results of testing and experiment indicate that the designed camera is capable of HDR LLL imaging.

articleTitle: Paring-free certificateless security authentication scheme for WSN based on ECC
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Because wireless sensor network (WSN) nodes have the limits of low storage resources, weak computing power and less electric power, the paper proposes a pairing-free certificateless security authentication scheme for WSN based on ECC algorithm. The scheme realizes mutual authentication, key agreement and session key update of nodes in the network using ECC point multiplication algorithm and AES symmetric encryption algorithm. Basing on this, we analyze the correctness and security, it shows that the scheme has two-party authentication, forward security, perfect-forward security, known-key security, anti-key leakage camouflage and other security attributes. Finally, we make the formal analysis of the performance of the scheme, and then we implement the simulation on the platform of OMNET++ basing on the language of C++. Comparing with other schemes, our scheme has less energy consumption and execution time, which can meet the needs of WSN better.

articleTitle: B-spline Interpolation methodology for Continuous Micro Line Segments Based on S-shaped velocity
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of uneven transition of inflection points in continuous micro-segments during high-speed machining, this paper proposes a method of high-speed machining of continuous micro-segments based on non-uniform B-spline curve interpolation algorithm and S-curve acceleration and deceleration algorithm. Firstly, the non-uniform B-spline algorithm is used to fit the small segments, and then the discrete S-curve acceleration and deceleration algorithm is used to plan the speed, so as to reduce the sudden change of acceleration and improve the surface integrity of the machined parts. The results show that the processing method can achieve smooth connection of small segments at inflection point, and improve the motion speed and interpolation accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Police UAVs Target Tracking Based on Improved Camshift Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: We proposed an improved Camshift algorithm for target tracking of police UAVs. To improve the traditional Camshift algorithm is vulnerable similar backgrounds, we propose an improved algorithm which combining LBP texture features with H and S extracted in HSV; By combining Kalman with Camshift, a prediction mechanism is introduced to improve the problem of easily influenced by object sheltering.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Power Load Automatic Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the traditional automatic monitoring of electric load, only one type of electric load can be monitored. It is difficult to separate and separate the electric load for simultaneous operation. Aiming at the shortcomings of small monitoring range and low accuracy, we designed an intelligent power load automatic detection system. The data collector and detector of the system are designed and the power load characteristic database is established. According to the established hardware system, the software system is designed to complete the collection of power load, data processing, feature classification and intelligent tracking. The experimental results show that the designed intelligent monitoring system can classify and monitor different types of electric loads at the same time, and the monitoring range is wide and the accuracy is high. Therefore, the system will play an important role in the precise management of power resources.

articleTitle: Process Research Based on Wavelet Analysis in Chatter Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The chatter problem in five-axis machining has always been a key issue in five-axis machining, so effective detection of chatter is very important. This paper mainly discusses the process details in chatter monitoring, selects the acceleration sensor to obtain the spindle signal, then uses wavelet analysis to extract the features of the signal, and uses the mode map or energy entropy to establish the threshold table, and finally achieves the purpose of chatter monitoring.

articleTitle: Semantic analysis of the Oracle Radicals using Similarity Strategy based on the Yolov2 network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Oracle bone inscriptions are the earliest character system in China, and its pattern is similar to the hieroglyphic. This paper selects 14 classes, including six different font evolution forms: oracle bone inscriptions, bronze inscriptions, states inscriptions, seal inscriptions, official scripts and regular scripts. Through the analysis of the combination of oracle radicals and the heads of oracle bones, and use convolutional neural networks to analyze the evolution of the oracle bones structure of the evolution process. In this experiment, this paper uses Yolov2 model to achieve oracle radical detection, and the results show that the oracle radical detection accuracy can reach 95.5%, meanwhile, we prove that some oracle radicals have similar structure relationships between the evolution of characters.

articleTitle: Recognition of Chinese finger sign language via gray-level co-occurrence matrix and K-nearest neighbor algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Having a definite expression, Chinese finger sign language obtains vital position in Chinese sign language recognition. In this work, we proposed a method for identifying Chinese finger sign language via gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) and K-nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm, which was a vision-based sign language recognition. We captured gesture images and segmented the hand shape, then converted these two-dimensional images into a gray-level co-occurrence matrix and extracted features based on appropriate angle and distance. At the same time, the KNN algorithm was used to classify based on the 10-fold cross-validation mode. We used this model to test 1110 finger images from 30 categories. Finally, the best classification accuracy of 95.3% was achieved. Therefore, our method was considered to be effective for Chinese finger sign language classification.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Unmanned Surface Vehicle Based on Improved Q-Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Efficient maritime navigation through obstructions is still one of the many problems faced by mariners. In this paper, the path planning method of mobile robots based on extensive research is used for reference, and the special requirements of Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) navigation process are considered. A USV path planning model based on improved Q- Learning (QL) algorithm is proposed. The improved QL algorithm is to introduce a strategy optimization selection model. The Q-Learning algorithm based on strategy optimization (SO- QL) can pre-screen behavior strategies, reduce the computational complexity of classical QL algorithm and accelerate the speed of path planning. The theoretical framework of reinforcement learning is Markov Decision Process (MDP), in which collision avoidance rules and marine environmental factors are fully taken into account. The simulation environment is built on Python and Pygame platforms. The simulation results show that the SO-QL algorithm is feasible and superior in obstacle avoidance and path planning under uncertain environmental information.

articleTitle: Detection Algorithm of Untwisted or Broken Strands of Transmission Line Based on FRAC
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The detection of untwisted or broken strands of the transmission line plays an important role in ensuring the longterm and steady operation of the transmission system. This paper proposes an enhanced Faster R-CNN with Attention Channel (FRAC) and a sliding crop algorithm and use them in an well-designed algorithm flow suitable for the detection of the strands defects. Firstly, the image is merged with an attention map produced by attention network and become a 4-channel picture. Then the sliding crop algorithm cuts it into subimages before sending it into our proposed FRAC. The experiment results demonstrate that this algorithm flow has a significant improvement over the original Faster R-CNN network.

articleTitle: Application Research of Mixed Reality (MR) Technology in Urban Historical Features Display
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The historical features of the city has valuable artistic value, displaying the historical features of the city can help the public better understand the process of urban change and development, enhance people's sense of cultural belonging and pride, and promote the integration and development of urban culture and tourism, which is of great significance to the protection and inheritance of urban history and culture. In this paper, the mixed reality technology is innovatively introduced into the historical display of the city, breaking the traditional two-dimensional display mode, constructing the urban historical appearance display system composed of the historical changes of the urban environment, the historical architectural space, and the important urban historical space. Then introduce the three-dimensional spatial perception into the historical display of the city, which can bring people the scene of virtual and real combination. So that the participants can interact with urban historic buildings and environments freely, which provide new methods for the display of urban historical features.

articleTitle: Abstract Memory Model For Complex Data Structures In Unit Testing
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Automated test case generation is one of the key points of automated unit testing. In path-oriented automated unit testing, the abstract memory model is used to accurately extract the semantics and constraints of variables on the path, which is a prerequisite for automatically generating test cases. However, the existing abstract memory model still has shortcomings, such as incomplete type support, difficulty in handling complex operations accurately. This paper focuses on improving the accuracy of the abstract memory model and the completeness of support. Based on the existing abstract memory model the paper proposes an optimized abstract memory model supporting the expression of numeric, pointer, structure, array, union. And the constraint extraction algorithm and the non-numeric test case shape construction algorithm are improved, which can more accurately simulate the semantics of complex operations and extract constraints. Based on the optimized abstract memory, it can provide more accurate and comprehensive information for automatic test case generation.

articleTitle: An Image Encryption Schema Based on Hybrid Optimized Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to improve the safety of chaotic image encryption algorithm. Firstly, to achieve this goal, it put forward two improved chaotic system logistic and henon, which covered an promoted henon chaotic system with better probability density, and an 2-dimension logistic chaotic system with high Lyapunov exponents. Secondly, the chaotic key stream was generated by the new 2D logistic chaotic system and optimized henon mapping, which mixed in dynamic proportions. The conducted sequence has better randomness and higher safety for image cryptosystem. Thirdly, we proposed algorithm takes advantage of the compounded chaotic system Simulation experiment results and security analysis showed that the proposed scheme was more effective and secure. It can resist various typical attacks, has high security, satisfies the requirements of image encryption theoretical.

articleTitle: A Monte Carlo localization Algorithm based on Ranging
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: To overcome the limitations of the traditional Monte Carlo localization (MCL) algorithm, such as complex sampling processes and excessive energy consumption of nodes, this paper proposed an MCL algorithm based on ranging. The MCL-R introduces Received Signal Strength(RSS)values to modify the weights between the anchor nodes and the unknown nodes, and controls the sampling environment dynamically. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has a lower sampling time and a higher sampling rate, which reduces the energy consumption required for positioning computations in sensor networks.

articleTitle: Process Deviation Calibration for Hardware Trojan Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In the process of hardware Trojan detection, the most popular method is side channel analysis. However, it is easily affected by process deviation, which usually leads to the unsatisfactory detection results of hardware Trojans. Therefore, due to the negative impacts caused by process deviation, a method that enables calibrating process deviation is presented in this paper. In this method, the ring oscillator network is employed to calibrate process deviation which is very sensitive to process deviation. The corresponding test chips were designed and fabricated. With the combination of test chips and Hspice simulation model, and under a series of data analysis and processing, the impact of process deviation can be reduced from 15.1% to 4.4% by eliminating the effect of the inter-chip process deviation.

articleTitle: A TDRSS Anti-jamming Method based on Frequency Hopping MSK Modulation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Due to the deficiency of the traditional PSK modulation modes, the anti-jamming performance of TDRSS high-speed digital transmission link could not be guaranteed. Based on constant envelope and high spectral efficiency of MSK modulation, TDRSS signal form was designed using MSK modulation combining with frequency hopping technique without increasing bandwidth. Simulations are carried out by modeling TDRSS communication system. It was verified that the link signal type proposed in this paper could improve broadband noise interference suppression ability. Furthermore, the partial band interference suppression capability had been analyzed. The result could provide methodology references to the anti-jamming development of TDRSS high-speed data transmission link.

articleTitle: Attention-based BiLSTM Model for Answer Extraction in Question Answering System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Answer extraction is the core technology of question answering (QA) system. Most of the previous works were based on syntactic features and knowledge base, which highly required the language knowledge. Accordingly, we proposed an attention-based bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) neural network model for answer extraction to automatically extract and analyze semantic features. The model remembers information in both forward and backward sequences to extract more complete semantic features. The attention mechanism assigns appropriate attention weights according to the semantic similarity of question-answer pairs, which enables the network to focus on the significant information and raises the probability of selecting the correct answer. We also study the prevailing semantic similarity calculation methods and choose the most suitable cosine similarity as the calculation criterion. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms the compared models.

articleTitle: Representative Spectral Extraction Approach for Hyperspectral Images Based on Mixed Spectral Similarity Metric
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, a representative spectral extraction approach for hyperspectral images based on mixed spectral similarity metric is proposed. The representative spectral can be used for spectral analysis and hyperspectral images quality assessment, which can promote the development of imaging spectrometers. First, we calculate the similarity matrix by mixed spectral similarity metric, which combines normalized Euclidean distance (NED), cosine of spectral angle metric (SAM) and spectral information divergence (SID). Then, DBSCAN clustering is used to extract representative spectral. Finally, we evaluate the accuracy of representative spectral by AdaBoost method. In this paper, the proposed algorithm is validated with the open hyperspectral data sets. Experimental results indicate that the proposed algorithm has high intraclass stability and interclass discrimination.

articleTitle: The Method of Building SBOM Based on Enterprise Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The technology of SBOM generation based on enterprise big data improved the efficiency and accuracy of enterprise product file data when the product is delivered to the customer. Through system integration, EBOM is used to build SBOM of product type. Then, the order data from ERP is used to build SBOM of order after comparing with SBOM of product type. Finally, the actual installation data from MES are added to SBOM of order to form SBOM of instance. The system about "Generation of SBOM" was established based on this technology, which has engineering applied in some company about researching and developing construction machinery. Production cycle of the manual based on SBOM reduced from the original 10 to 20 days for 3 to 5 hours, generated accurate product electronic record, and achieved one machine correspondence with its manual. The accuracy of the technical file content improved significantly.

articleTitle: A Fast High-Precision Ranging Algorithm of LFMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: LFMCW radar is one of the main systems of radar liquidometer. The liquid level distance can be obtained by estimating the difference frequency between the transmitting wave and echo,. A fast discrete frequency interpolation algorithm is presented for high-precision ranging of LFMCW radar liquidometer. Through experiments and practical operation, it is proved that measuring precision of this algorithm can reach 1 millimeter, and the operating speed id high.

articleTitle: Dilated Recurrent Neural Network for Epidemiological Predictions
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) is an acute febrile and exudative infectious disease caused by enterovirus, which children are susceptible to. It spreads among children mainly through the digestive tract, respiratory tract and close contact, etc. Currently, since, lack of effective therapeutic drugs, symptomatic treatment is widely adopted. Therefore, accurate prediction of the number of HFMD patients is very important for the prevention and control of HFMD. In this paper, a predicting model, which is based on the Dilated Recurrent Neural Network (DRNN), is proposed to predict the future number of HFMD patients for different prediction horizons. Experimental results, based upon recorded time series data about the number of hand, foot and mouth disease cases in Xiamen, demonstrate that our model improves the forecast well compared to a set of widely-used methods for time series prediction.

articleTitle: Incremental Quadratic Constrained Nonlinear Adaptive Reduced-Order Observer and Its Application to Chaos Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper introduces a class of nonlinear adaptive observer design problems, and its nonlinear term satisfies the incremental quadratic constraints. The output estimation error term is first inserted into the full-order observer and constructed into a circular criterion observer. In addition, the state estimation error of the reduced-order observer is converged to zero at the exponential rate, and the real-time performance is better. The sufficient condition for the existence of the observer is given by the linear matrix inequality, which is easy to solve. Finally, taking a typical Lorenz chaotic system as an example, the effectiveness of the synchronization scheme is illustrated by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: A parallel iteration algorithm for greedy selection based IDW mesh deformation in OpenFOAM
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Inverse Distance Weighting (IDW) interpolation based mesh deformation is an explicit technique adopted by large-scale mesh computation for Computational Fluid Dynamic (CFD). To obtain the optimum interpolating points set, greedy algorithm is utilized widely in the interpolation process. However, greedy algorithm will bring additional time cost because of its recycling point selection. This paper proposes a parallel iteration algorithm for greedy selection based IDW mesh deformation in OpenFOAM (a widely used software of CFD).The iteration method is proposed based on that some computing values are recycling in greedy loop and it make the computational complexity reduce from O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) to O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). The parallel algorithm is based on the re-decompositon method which can greatly keep the load balancing. The experiments are operated on a three-dimensional undulating fish model with 3.7 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> mesh cells. Results show that our parallel iteration method could obtain a more than 18.2 times performance increase, compared with the conventional greedy algorithm applied in IDW interpolation.

articleTitle: Study on non-direct signal transmission and characteristic of human body communication
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the increasing concern of body area network system in medical field, the intelligent wearable robot and wearable devices develop fast than ever. In this article, the nondirect link include chest-back and chest-leg link are taken into consideration. The comparison of surface link and linear link to the non-direct link are analysed. The conclusion shows in chest-back link, the surface distance play a decisive role and has a time delay. But in chest-leg link. the surface link and linear link are almost the same as the non-direct link, but the received cause distortion from the multipath affect.

articleTitle: Generative Adversarial Networks for Multi-agent Consistency System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The inconsistency of the states of agents in infinite discrete time domain is a kernel problem that must be addressed. In this study, the optimal strategy of distributed suboptimal controller is proposed under the framework of generating adversarial networks to optimize the state disparity between agents. Firstly, the Nash equilibrium solution is obtained by calculating the game between the generator and the discriminator, which is used as a qualification condition for multi-agent consistency. Then, with the minimum cost function as the performance optimization index, the control vector function is proposed that make the actual output of the system always follows the change of the expected state. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed suboptimal controller is verified by simulation experiments. The simulation results show that the selected control vector function minimizes the cost function and satisfies the optimal solution for generating adversarial networks framework. At this time, the multi-agent system can not only achieve multi-agent consistency, but also greatly improve the consistency accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Jet-assisted Support and Post-processing Technology for Mirror Milling System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: As a new type of high-tech thin-walled parts processing equipment, the research on the support side structure and post- processing of the dual-five-axis mirror milling system is rare. Based on this, a jet-assisted support structure is proposed, which uses water jet as an assistant support to improve the deformation of thin-walled parts. This paper presents a post-processing method for the dual-five-axis mirror milling system. Firstly, kinematics analysis of the milling side and the supporting side is carried out. Then, based on the NC codes generated on both sides, an algorithm of NC codes combination based on the same tool position data is proposed, which combines the NC codes on both sides to achieve the purpose of controlling the movement of machine tools on both sides with a set of NC codes. VERICUT simulation results and experimental results verify the feasibility of the post-processing method, which is suitable for mirror milling system.

articleTitle: Research on Data Analysis for Time Deposit of Bank Customers Based on Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Nowadays, time deposit is considered to be the main business of banks but due to the rapid development of the Internet which has a great impact on the financial service products of banks. More and more people choose to invest time deposits in Internet financial products, which also mean to lose bank's financial client holders. This paper is based on data analysis of 21 influencing factors of whether bank customers are subscribed to time deposits or not and to find out the important features of customer's subscription to time deposits by constructing an ensemble learning model and finally evaluating the model to obtain a better prediction model.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Children's Wear Model Based on Improved BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to alleviate the extreme shortage, casual resignation of clothing designers, and the continuous improvement of the need for individual customization, we have come up with an improved BP algorithm which using children's easy-to-measure parts size data to forecast the size of complex parts required for different children's wear. We made and produced the predicted data to meet the actual requirements. This study compares the predicted results of the improved BP algorithm with those of the original BP algorithm and other algorithms, proving that the improved BP algorithm is with stronger stability, higher accuracy and faster convergence speed. The data required for pattern making is predicted by the improved BP algorithm, and the error between the forecast data and the actual data is as high as 99% within 0.3 cm, which is more advantageous than other algorithms in learning various clothing types and realizing monomer customization.

Index Terms: Activation Function Of The Hidden Layer

articleTitle: Automatic detection method for iced transmission lines under complex background
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Ice coating on transmission lines is very likely to cause major accidents such as flashover trips and inverted towers. In order to accurately and effectively monitor the ice-covered condition of transmission lines, this paper intends to use an optimization learning algorithm to extract the contours quickly. Firstly, the adaptive probability filter is used to denoise the iced image to reduce the influence of noise in complex environments. Then, the edge point and the non-edge point of a single image are studied by genetic programming without real edge points, which is quickly classifying and connecting the target edge points to adaptively obtain the contour of the transmission line. Finally, after comparing the relevant edge information of the transmission line before and after icing, the thickness of the ice coating could be obtained measured by pixel. The experimental results show that the method can adaptively extract the transmission lines under different backgrounds and improve the accuracy of automatic calculation of ice thickness.

articleTitle: Comprehensive error modeling and compensation of five-axis mirror milling machine
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The mirror image of the milling side and the processing side of a five-axis milling machine is followed by three moving pairs and two rotating pairs on each side, which can achieve high-precision machining of thin-wall parts, but its error compensation movement is more complex. Because there is a certain coupling relationship between the error compensation amount of each moving pair and the error value (position and direction error) between the cutter and the workpiece. The motion characteristics of the five-axis mirror milling machine are analyzed, and then the transformation matrix between the coordinates of each motion sub-coordinate is established by the square coordinate transformation. Based on the error compensation operation assumption error motion is analyzed and the relationship between the compensation movement, every motion pair of five-axis machine tool position and orientation error compensation movement decoupling, can build space five mathematical model for calculating the error compensation mirror for five-axis milling machine tool error real-time compensation provides a theoretical basis.

articleTitle: Fuzzy C-Mean Brain Tumor Image Segmentation Based on Multi-feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: A new Fuzzy C-Means algorithm based on multi-feature fusion FMFCM was proposed in this paper, aiming at the problem of poor anti-noise performance and low segmentation accuracy of Fuzzy C-Mean Clustering (FCM) algorithm. The brain tumor MR image was taken by the algorithm as the experimental object, extracted the gray value, spatial information and local binary pattern of the brain image as multi-dimensional features to segment, and tested the anti-noise performance of the image by adding different intensity of Gaussian noise and salt and pepper noise. Experiments show that compared with FLICM algorithm FRFCM and FCM-S2 algorithm, The proposed algorithm improves the partition coefficient (Vpc) by 6.9%, 10.3% and 13.2% respectively, and reduces the partition entropy (Vpe) by 16.2%, 11.8% and 15.2%, respectively. The segmentation accuracy is improved by 2.2%, 1.6% and 3% respectively. The proposed algorithm has better robustness to noise and can achieve better segmentation results.

articleTitle: The Curcuit Design and Simulation on Narrowband High-frequeney Power Amplifier Based on Multisim
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: High frequency resonance Class C power amplifier is one of very important functional circuit of high frequency circuits. The Class C power amplifier is usually divided into three working states including under -voltage, over-voltage and critical state. The working state of the circuit is affected not only by the parameters of the triode but also by the parameters of other components in the circuit. In order to realize the function of narrow band high frequency power amplifier, we use Class C amplifier in the design and research of the circuit. The simulation experiments of the amplifier are performed with Multisim 14 software. Lots of data and charts are obtained in the experiments, and the influence of the external parameters on the working state of the circuit is discussed, then the feed circuit and filter matching network is designed. The matching network designed by the network analyzer could achieve a good match, and the output power of the narrow band high frequency power amplifier was 1W, and the power gain reached to 24dB.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-notch UWB Antenna Based on CPW-Feed
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel multi-notch ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna based on coplanar waveguide (CPW)feeding. The proposed antenna has a pair of square split resonator rings (SRRs) that can control the notch frequency. Two notch frequencies of 2.6 GHz and 6.0 GHz have been obtained by the SRRs loading and the regular hexagonal split ring slotting, and the double notch characteristics are realized. The design results show that the antenna can achieve broadband characteristics in the 2.0-8.0 GHz band, and the return loss(S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>) is lower than -10 dB, forming a stop band of 2.8-3.0 GHz and 5.-86.2 GHz.

articleTitle: A piezoelectric energy harvester for the intelligent self-sufficient spherical detector application
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel design of a piezoelectric energy harvester for the Spherical Detector (SD) in pipelines. The harvester converts the rotating mechanical energy into electrical energy and develops an intelligent self-sufficient SD to break the limits of traditional SD application distances. A dynamic model suitable for design is derived through the Euler-Lagrange method and the design process is introduced in detail. The rotational motion frequency is measured by a pipeline test with a MEMS triaxial accelerometer. An experimental platform with Macro Fiber Composite is built. After load optimization, 27.64 mW is obtained at 2.4 Hz. The results demonstrate that the proposed piezoelectric energy harvester has the potential to establish an intelligent self-sufficient spherical detector.

articleTitle: Gradual Image Outpainting with Pixel to Pixel Mapping
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: As a computer vision problem, image inpainting aiming at restoring the missing portions within an image has been widely studied. Motivated by inpainting, we begin to research outpainting, which extrapolates beyond image boundaries. Then an image can be expanded arbitrarily by recursive outpainting. Image outpainting based on deep learning can be regarded as an information generation problem from the input image to the corresponding output image. With deep convolutional network and conditional generative adversarial structure, our trained model generates the plausible outpainting contents of a specific image. We adopt two subnetworks based on residual net and U-net to replace the single encoder-decoder structure in the most existing image inpainting networks. The first half of the generator network is used to generate rough outline images, while the second half is used to enhance outline images to clear outpainted images with pixel to pixel mapping. Experimental results show that the generated contents are smoothly integrated with the pixels around the boundaries and express real semantics together with the input image.

articleTitle: Automatic fairing Algorithm for B-Spline Curves Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, a B-Spline curve fairing algorithm considering both curve fairness and curve error is proposed. A new control point adjustment strategy is proposed, which preprocesses the bad points and bad areas on the curve to ensure that the curve has no redundant inflection points. In the particle swarm optimization algorithm, the error accuracy is taken as the constraint condition, the flight space of the particles in the population is limited, and the proposed fairness measure is used as the objective function to update the population iteratively. An example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the curve fairing algorithm in this paper.

articleTitle: Web Service QoS Prediction via Exploiting Locatoin and Trustworthy Information
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: When historical matrix is very sparse and matrix data is unreliable due to untrustworthy service users, the QoS prediction results is inaccurate. In this study, a method to prediction Web service QoS is presented through exploiting location and trustworthy information. Firstly, for obtaining candidate untrustworthy users, QoS similar users and geographically similar users, the QoS information and user geographic information are divided by K-means clustering algorithm. And then, the unknown service QoS values are predicted by using the QoS information of similar users only from trustworthy users. Comprehensive experiments are conducted on a real-world Web service QoS dataset. The experimental results indicate that our method outperforms the other QoS prediction methods.

articleTitle: Saliency detection based on the fusion of spatial and frequency domain analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Saliency detection is a challenging direction in the field of computer vision. To get the more accurate salient target, we propose a visual saliency detection method based on the fusion of spatial and frequency domain analysis. Firstly, the image is smoothed by a Gaussian filter and then segmented by the superpixel segmentation of SLIC. The spatial saliency map is calculated by the color distance. Secondly, the saliency map of frequency domain is obtained by hypercomplex Fourier transform. Finally, the point multiplication operation is adopted to merge the spatial and the frequency domain saliency map. Compared with the others methods, the model we proposed can well retain the complete contour, highlight the target and suppress the background<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.</sup>

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Value Evaluation of Optical Transmission Link Based on Constellation Diagram
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the modeling and value evaluation of optical transport networks. The relationship between bit error rate and signal-to-noise ratio is established by three constellations of QPSK, 8QAM and 16QAM signal modulation formats. Based on the signal-to-noise ratio analysis, the optical transmission link is modeled to reduce the signal-to-noise ratio tolerance, and the way to improve the constellation is explored.

articleTitle: Research on Cooling System of High Power Semiconductor Laser Based on Thermoelectric Semiconductor Refrigerator
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The cooling system of high power semiconductor laser based on thermoelectric semiconductor refrigerator is designed to solve the instability of output power of laser caused by temperature rise. Bi2Te3 thermoelectric cooler with maximum thermoelectric optimum coefficient at room temperature can accurately control the temperature in the range of 0.1 °C. It realizes the dual functions of refrigeration and heating by loading lower DC voltage at both ends and changing the direction of current. The laser works in the optimum temperature range, which can make the output of the laser safer and more stable. The experimental equipment is set up and the whole system is tested. The experimental results show that the temperature of heat sink increases with the increase of environmental temperature and tends to accelerate. The temperature of heat sink is relatively stable in the range of general medical treatment environmental temperature from 20°C to 30°C. The output power of high power laser based on thermoelectric semiconductor refrigerator is tested at a typical environmental temperature of 25°C. The deviation between the output power and the target power is less than 2%, which can meet the stable output of high power semiconductor laser treatment and ensure the stability and safety of laser output.

articleTitle: Research on the Automatic Test of Smart TV Operating System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: We designed and proposed one automatic test platform and test case for technical compliance of Smart TV Operating System (TVOS) based on the analysis of the requirements of automatic test of TVOS, according to the function and architecture of TVOS. This automatic test will greatly accelerate the quick and efficient deployment of TVOS in the networks of broadcasting and television all around China and make sure the technical compliance. We intended to realize the automatic test of each software layer, module and massive interfaces of TVOS through the effective and flexible coordination between automatic test platform and test cases. This will solve the former problem of low efficiency of test in technical compliance of TVOS.

articleTitle: Gradient Projection for SAR Image Sparse Reconstruction Based on Shearlet
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel method to synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging is proposed. The approach is based on gradient projection (GP) to reconstruct the image in shearlet domain, which optimizes a quadratic error term of the SAR observation subject to interested scene sparsity. Compare with the traditional SAR imaging technology, the novel method uses lower sampling rate than the Nyquist rate. We test variants of this approach that select the line search parameters in different ways, including techniques based on the Barzilai-Borwein method. The experiment show that these GP approaches perform better and faster (in terms of computation) others methods.

articleTitle: Assisted analysis of acne metagenomics sequencing data based on FP-Growth method
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: As a high incidence of chronic inflammatory skin disease, acne has a complex etiology and pathogenesis, and microbial colonization is currently considered as one of the important causes. Therefore, in this paper metagenomics data is analyzed using Frequent-Pattern Growth (FP-Growth) method for aided diagnosis of acne disease. The main ideas include that firstly, the data sets are transformed into binary form of 0 or 1. The original data of lipids whose component content is 0 is set 0, and the original data of lipids whose component content is not 0 is set 1. Then the data sets are scanned to build a frequent pattern tree (FP-tree) based on the frequency of each element and support. Finally, FP-tree is used to determine frequent itemsets. The element items in frequent itemsets correspond to the lipids which are highly correlated with the corresponding data. Experimental results on dataset including normal control (NC), acne healthy skin (HS) and acne diseased skin (DS) show that the proposed method can determine the frequent itemsets of different sample sets. Lipids that can distinguish different skin states are also determined by comparing the difference of frequent itemsets, which can provide guiding help for the auxiliary analysis and treatment of skin acne.

articleTitle: Maneuverability Range Prediction of Gliding Vehicle Based on Structure-optimized GA -BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: To meet the requirement for future volatile battlefield, gliding vehicles' complex mission and multi- constraint trajectory planning call for efficient maneuverability range prediction method. This paper proposes a novel gliding vehicle maneuverability range prediction method based on structure-optimized GA-BP neural network. The sample trajectories are obtained by hp-adaptive Gauss pseudospectral method. To obtain the global optimum network, the network's initial weights, thresholds and structure are all optimized. Different variables are separately encoded with hybrid encoding method. During the genetic process, GA's training performance is further improved by adaptive adjustment of crossover and permutation operation probability. The training and test results are compared to verify the method's accuracy and efficiency advantage over the BP and structure-invariant GA-BP. The results show that the proposed method can avoid to be stuck in local optimum value and effectively improve the maneuverability range prediction's accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Fingertip Detection Based on the Chord-to-Point Distance Accumulation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Fingertip detection is an important part of vision-based human-computer interaction. Due to the complexity of background and the real-time capability of system, there still exist many problems in the accuracy of fingertip positioning. In view of these problems, this paper proposed a simple and efficient fingertip detection method. First, the input video stream is preprocessed, and then the hand contour is extracted. The obtained hand contour is processed by the Chord-to-Point Distance Accumulation algorithm, so as to detect the fingertip in the image. The experimental results show that the method has high accuracy and stability in fingertip recognition.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Marine Engine Room Simulation Test System Based on ZeroMQ Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Intelligent ships are the direction of future ship development, and their reliability has become the key to the development of this technology. In this paper, a simulation test system based on the marine engine room simulator is established to test the safety and stability of the intelligent application system for the intelligent ship. The test system uses the marine engine room simulator operating state to obtain test data, and uses ZeroMQ (Zero Message Queue) to establish a communication mechanism to realize data communication between the test system and the intelligent ship-related intelligent application system.

articleTitle: Anti-Multipath Interference Method using Brewster Effect and Modified Proportional Navigation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper proposed a novel method to suppress multipath interference by utilizing Brewster Effect and modified proportional navigation. A modified Four-Path model was established by introducing complex reflection coefficient and antenna pattern to analyze multipath interference. A modified proportional navigation which can restrain line-of-sight angle near Brewster angle was derived to achieve angular constraint. Some simulations were carried and showed the good result of anti-multipath interference.

articleTitle: Solid Modeling and Intersection Detection of Large Terrain Body Based on OpenGL
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Solid modeling of 3D terrain body has always been a hot topic in the field of computer graphics. To improve the efficiency of 3D model rendering, this paper proposes a new rapid solid modeling for large-scale geological data environment, and the intersection of the virtual model with the imaginary surface is detected.

articleTitle: Voltage Disturbance Compensator based Control Strategy for Three-phase Voltage Source Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: For three-phase voltage source pulse width modulation (PWM) converter, there is existing distortion in the grid currents and exhibiting fluctuation in the DC bus voltage under inner-loop voltage disturbance. In this paper, a robust control strategy based on voltage disturbance compensator (VDC) is introduced into the double closed-loop control structure to suppress the current distortion and voltage fluctuation. The design and compensation mechanism of the VDC is presented. The stability of the system is analyzed by investigating the real and imaginary part of the closed-loop poles. Simulation and experiments are carried out to validate the proposed control strategy. The results indicate that the three-phase voltage source PWM converter shows a strong robustness under external disturbance when the proposed VDC is applied. Compared with the traditional PI control strategy, it is found that grid currents are highly sinusoidal and DC bus voltage has small fluctuation with the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Theoretical Analysis of Interference Effect in Multilayer Medium
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In order to discuss the transmission characteristic of electromagnetic wave in multilayer medium, three-layer medium model is constructed in this paper. Based on physics process of interaction between electromagnetic wave and medium, we deduced the integrated expression of refection coefficient and transmission coefficient. According to the calculation of conversation of energy of electromagnetism, the correctness of the expression is testified. It is proved that the reflected wave and transmission wave are mixed with innumerability echoes, and its energy is the summation of these echoes' energy, but not the energy of the summation of echoes. So there is no real sense of total transmission.

articleTitle: A approximation algorithm to solve the maximum multicommodity flow problem with local dominant
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The present work studies a maximum multicommodity flow problem with local constrains, which not only enrich the content of the multicommodity flow problem, but also can be used to operate optimization decisions of some practical problems, such as the logistics distribution problems stemming out of transportations. The major contributions are as follows: (A) A multicommodity flow problem is developed and the existence of its solutions is studied. (B) An approximation algorithm to solve the defined problem is designed. (C) The approximation measures as well as the time complexity of the designed algorithm is proposed and proved.

articleTitle: The Optimum Autofrettage and Fatigue Prediction Based on Finite-Element Method for High Pressure Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: An autofrettage model of high pressure cylinder was established based on the bilinear kinematic hardening (BKIN) material in which the strain hardening and Bauschinger effect were considered. Theoretical calculations and finite-element results were performed and compared to obtain the optimum autofrettage pressure. These results clearly show good agreement between the two cases with a maximum difference of 3.1%, indicating that the theoretical solution agrees well with the simulation. Based on the stress-life method, a fatigue life prediction of high pressure cylinder was performed by Ncode Designlife software. Results show that autofrettage process increases the minimum fatigue life of high pressure cylinder by 15 times about.

articleTitle: Implementation of DRM Receiver Based on Android Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Today, digital broadcasting technology represented by DRM(Digital Radio Mondiale) is gradually replacing the traditional analog AM broadcasting. In this context, the source code of digital AM broadcast transceiver software based on DRM standard is released in foreign countries. The main job of this paper is to transplant the DRM receiver on the PC to the Android platform with Android Studio.

articleTitle: Phase Division of Flight Data Based on Maximum Lyapunov Index
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, the flight phase partitioning method (FPPM) is proposed against the problems of low generalization and high training cost in the current flight phase division research. The method first utilize one-dimensional height data reflecting phase characteristics to complete phase space reconstruction (PSR), which aims to restore the original system dynamic characteristics in the phase space. Then the value of the maximum lyapunov index (MLI) of the reconstructed sequence at different stages is calculated to quantitatively describe the chaotic characteristics at each stage. Finally, different flight phases are distinguished according to the numerical difference in MLI of reconstruction sequences at each stages. Multiple real-life flight data from one certain model aircraft is exploited to verify the validity. The result shows that the FPPM can quickly and accurately identify the flight data at different stages, with strong practicability and generalization.

articleTitle: Coexistence Analysis Between NB-IoT and LTE-R/Broadcasting Service System in 450MHz-470MHz Band
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Based on the 450-470MHz interference coexistence scenario, this paper uses deterministic analysis method to analyze the coexistence of 458-460MHz/468-470MHz NB-IoT system and 453-458MHz /463-468MHz LTE-R system, the coexistence of 468-470MHz NB-IoT system and 470-478MHz Broadcasting Service System, and obtains the corresponding isolation requirements. On the basis of comprehensive analysis, the interference avoidance measures for the coexistence of the system are proposed, which can provide reference for the frequency planning of 450-470MHz band.

articleTitle: Analyze on Space Target Detection Capability of Ground-based Radar Based on STK
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: The STK (Systems Tool Kit) is used to study the space target detection capability of ground-based radar. Based on radar equation, the influencing factors of radar detection ability are analyzed from three kinds of parameters: system constant, statistical variable and atmospheric environment. The quantitative relationship between radar range, radar elevation and target height is calculated and given. In view of the limitation of STK phased array antenna model, considering the size constraints of mobile radar, a parabolic antenna is selected and a STK-based ground radar model is constructed by combining radar mode, transmitter, receiver and other components. The main performance parameters of the radar system are given. Case simulation is carried out for FIA5 satellite, the simulation results show that the ground-based radar can effectively detect and track the target 158s and the detection range of the target is 1094.8-1223.5km.

articleTitle: Real-time intersection strategy of angular measuring data
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: Real-time intersection measurement is an important application of TT&C equipment. Most of the current researches of intersection are focusing on the intersection algorithm itself or data preprocessing method, but few revealing how to ensure intersection' real-time requirement. Based on the two scenarios of having time system and not, this paper expounds two practical real-time intersection strategies, which have been tested in simulation and real tasks and fully ensures that the program can execute the intersection algorithm after receiving appropriate amount of data. the strategies have high practical value.

articleTitle: Real-time human hand following system based on multiple vision sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This paper designs a real-time human hand following system based on multi-vision sensors. Through the KinectV2 camera, human hand behavior can be observed; the pose information of the human hand joint can also be obtained by using OpenNI2 and NITE2 interface; calculating the angle information of each joint of the six-degree-of-freedom robot can be achieved by stereo geometric correlation calculation. Through LeapMotion, accurate human joint information is obtained, then calculating the finger distance to control manipulator's tension, which is smoothed by Kalman filtering. Control, simulation and visualization for real-time follow-up of the robotic arm and the human hand are achieved under the Robot Operating System(ROS). The final experimental results are verified by Moveit's simulation environment and Kinova's Jaco arm.

articleTitle: Surface acoustic wave CO2 gas sensor based on electric loading effect
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: This letter describes a novel Surface Acoustic Wave (SAW) sensor for carbon dioxide (CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) detection based on electric loading effect with a graphene (G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>)/nickel (Ni) - L-alanine- Al sandwich structure (MIM) as a sensing capacitance. This capacitance, which is fully coated on the IDTs and reflectors of SAW device and is sensitive to the pH value of the environment, is paralleled with the static capacitance (C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</sub>) of IDTs constructing an equivalent static capacitance (C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</sub>'). When the concentration of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> increased from 0 ppm to 40000 ppm, the equivalent static capacitance decreased from 5.402pF to 4.358pF. Then the center frequency of SAW sensor increases 20 kHz due to the electric loading effect. And the sensitivity of the fabricated SAW sensor for CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas was about 0.38 MHz/ (ppm*m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>).

articleTitle: Multi-type Ant Colony Algorithm for Optimizing Land Use in The Main City of Kunming
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the development of economy and the advancement of urbanization, human activities have led to great changes in urban underlying surface attributes. The increase of high thermal storage material and the decrease of green space make the urban form a heat island effect. The vegetation coverage and the urban surface temperature have been calculated and retrieved from the remote sensing image of Landsat 8 to mitigate the urban heat island effect since 2014. Based on multi-type ant colony algorithm, combined with the GDAL(Geospatial Data Abstraction Library) and OpenCV Library, the land use of Kunming was optimized from four aspects. The results show that the optimized land use situation can improve the land adaptability and tightness in Kunming. The average land surface temperature of the main urban area of Kunming can be effectively reduced and the urban heat island effect can be alleviated.

articleTitle: Attitude control of tail-adjustable seabed sediment temperature probe with PID controller
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: A new type of tail-adjustable seafloor sediment temperature probe and its attitude control method is presented in this paper. The adjustable tail makes the gravity movement of the probe system in the water controllable, improving the stability and anti-interference ability of the system, and miniaturizing the probe. Through the modeling of the probe system, the equation between the tile angle angular acceleration and the angle of the adjustable tail is derived. By analyzing the equation, the open-loop transfer function of the first-order inertia link is obtained. Further, through the PID controller and its parameter setting, the dynamic performance of the system is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Tool performance prediction of fabricating humps on different cutting tools by Numerical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, the effect of humps on tool properties and cutting process on tool surface is studied. It is found that the tool temperature in cutting process can be effectively reduced and the wear of tool tip can be reduced by adding humps to three standard tools and carrying out simulation analysis. Humps on tool surface can reduce chip thickness by secondary cutting, which is beneficial to chip breaking. Humps on different cutting tools can effectively improve the performance of cutting tools. This paper can effectively guide the preparation of special cutting tools.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High-Voltage System for Ion Mobility Spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: In this paper, a high-voltage system for ion mobility spectrometer was designed to realize the electric field of drift tube and ion gate switching function. Based on the high-voltage circuit and FPGA program, fast switching of positive and negative 2500V and ion gate were implemented. In order to verify the system function, we used the DMMP chemical reagent as the sample for analysis and test. The experimental results indicated that the ion mobility spectrometer could quickly collect positive and negative ion mobility spectra, and the high-voltage system ran reliably. The noise and baseline of the collected ion mobility spectra was at low level. The system meets the detection requirements of the ion mobility spectrometer.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wireless Channel Model Characteristics in the High-Speed Railway Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Technology and Computer Engineering (EITCE)
abstract: With the complexity of the surrounding environment of the high-speed railways(HSR) and the fast-moving of trains, the wireless channel propagation characteristics are quite different from ordinary channels. In this paper, firstly, the conventional channel modeling methods is introduced and highspeed railway common scenarios are classified. Then, the HSR wireless channel model in different scenarios is built based on the TDL model. Finally, the characteristics of channels based on the TDL model in different scenarios are analyzed and compared. The simulation results show that the TDL model can be well applied to channel modeling in high-speed railway scenarios.
